string.name: c15_s4
string.value: Master...I won't do that again...BEEP BEEP...

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: What did I do anyway~! BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: Master that wasn't cool at all! BEEP BEEP~!

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: Where else will you find an obedient robot like me? BEEP BEEP~!

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: Master! If you keep doing that, I may one day get out of here! BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: I won't do that again. I promise.

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: I didn't do anything wrong, though!

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: Hey, things happen in life and I am not going to apologize for it.

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: Man...going off on me again for no reason...

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: Master must be bored, so here I'm, listening to all that garbage.

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: So who am I attacking? BEEP BEEP...

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: Ready for launch, master! Beep beep.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: Get ready for my super arm extension. BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: I'm ready to fire these missiles! BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: I believe in peace, master. BEEP BEEP.

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: No, I don't feel like it. BEEP BEEP.

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: I'm running out of oil. Feed me first. BEEP BEEP.

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: I'm already in an attack mode! BEEP BEEP

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: What should I use? I've got a lot of weapons at my arsenal. Beep beep.

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: At your service, master. BEEP BEEP

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: I'm ready to fire these missiles! BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: An error occurred while withdrawing the weapon. BEEP BEEP.

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: Not after the way you treated me last night. BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: I think the nuts have come loose. Please tighten them for me. BEEP BEEP.

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: Who am I supposed to attack? BEEP BEEP.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: I've been greased up just for this occasion. Bring it on!!

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: Snails don't scare me. I'm ready to back you up!

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Only the robots are blessed with iron fists. These babies are ready for attack.

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: I don't feel like attacking anyone else. That's YOUR job!

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: Huh? What attack? What do you think I am, a rocket launcher or something?

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I do not believe in violence. I CAN, however, give you some motivational speeches.

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: Um... I need to be refueled. Feed me first, then we'll talk.

string.name: c22_s1
string.value: I love you too, BEEP BEEP~

string.name: c22_s2
string.value: Hey, robots can blush, too! BEEP BEEP~

string.name: c22_f2
string.value: What did you say, BEEP BEEP?

string.name: c23_s3
string.value: I like you too~ BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: I like you very very much! BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c23_f1
string.value: Master, give me some food...BEEP BEEP...

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: Ah...I was thinking of something else...BEEP BEEP

string.name: c24_s1
string.value: I love you too, master! Seriously!

string.name: c24_s2
string.value: You sure know how to warm a cold robotic heart!

string.name: c24_s3
string.value: The same goes to you too, master!

string.name: c24_f2
string.value: Master needs to say the truth.

string.name: c24_f3
string.value: Don't lie to me! You can't love a robot!

string.name: c24_f4
string.value: If you love me, then feed me right now.

string.name: c25_s2
string.value: I know you like this. BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c25_s3
string.value: I know I know, robots can be beautiful, too. BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c25_s4
string.value: Looking good, right? What? You want an autograph? BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c25_f1
string.value: No way! I don't feel like doing it right now! BEEP BEEP

string.name: c25_f2
string.value: Show me how YOU do it, BEEP BEEP

string.name: c25_f3
string.value: And your point for me doing this is ... beep beep.

string.name: c26_s1
string.value: Master, what do you think? My eyes shall be called the twinkling stars... BEEP BEEPr...

string.name: c26_s2
string.value: Hello, I define charisma! Look, BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c26_s3
string.value: I know you can't resist these beautifyl eyes. BEEP BEEP...

string.name: c26_s4
string.value: Do you want a piercing look? This is just short of shooting laser beams...BEEP BEEP

string.name: c26_f1
string.value: If you feed me, I'll think about it...

string.name: c26_f2
string.value: Ouch, my eyes hurt. BEEP BEEP...

string.name: c26_f3
string.value: The sun's in my eye, and it doesn't feel good... BEEP BEEPr...

string.name: c26_f4
string.value: Can I do it later? BEEP BEEP...

string.name: c27_s2
string.value: This is dedicated to my master!! Check this out!

string.name: c27_s3
string.value: Hollywood is looking for the next great robot actor, me!

string.name: c27_s4
string.value: The guy that made me told me I look the best!

string.name: c27_f2
string.value: Feed me. Feed me. Feed me.

string.name: c27_f3
string.value: I don't want to do it. Seriously.

string.name: c28_s1
string.value: I wonder who made me. I should call that person dad or mom, depending on who that was, BEEP BEEP~

string.name: c28_s2
string.value: If you defeat high-leveled monsters, you'll most likely be rewarded with a nice item, BEEP BEEP...

string.name: c28_s3
string.value: Isn't it nice out here today? We should go far and have fun wherever on a day like this, BEEP BEEP...

string.name: c28_s4
string.value: Master, can you grease me up a bit? I feel ... um ... stiff. BEEP BEEP.

string.name: c28_f1
string.value: Do you really think robots say anything other than BEEP BEEP?

string.name: c28_f2
string.value: I'm too depressed to talk right now, BEEP BEEP~

string.name: c28_f4
string.value: I'm a robot, and robots only beep. BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c29_s1
string.value: I wonder who made me. I should call that person dad or mom, depending on who that was, BEEP BEEP~

string.name: c29_s2
string.value: If you defeat high-leveled monsters, you'll most likely be rewarded with a nice item, BEEP BEEP...

string.name: c29_s3
string.value: Isn't it nice out here today? We should go far and have fun wherever on a day like this, BEEP BEEP...

string.name: c29_s4
string.value: Master, can you grease me up a bit? I feel ... um ... stiff. BEEP BEEP.

string.name: c29_f1
string.value: Do you really think robots say anything other than BEEP BEEP?

string.name: c29_f2
string.value: I'm too depressed to talk right now, BEEP BEEP~

string.name: c29_f4
string.value: I'm a robot, and robots only beep. BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c30_s1
string.value: I feel good right now! BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c30_s2
string.value: The 8-ball in me tells me that we're getting a sweet item today! BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c30_s3
string.value: Master, contrary to popular belief, we robots do have emotions! BEEP BEEP~

string.name: c30_s4
string.value: Can you take me to Ludibrium? I heard that place is full of robots like me!

string.name: c30_f2
string.value: I feel like resting right now ~BEEP BEEP~

string.name: c30_f3
string.value: I have little to say...BEEP BEEP...

string.name: c31_s1
string.value: Hook me up with a date, master!

string.name: c31_s2
string.value: Have you heard of El Nath? I heard it's so cold, that I may even freeze in there!

string.name: c31_s4
string.value: Am I screwd on tight? Or am I loose somewhere?

string.name: c31_f1
string.value: Even a robot can use some food every now and then.

string.name: c31_f2
string.value: Are you sick of me, master?

string.name: c32_s2
string.value: This is always fun! BEEP BEEP!!

string.name: c32_s3
string.value: Look! Look! Don't I look good? BEEP BEEP?

string.name: c32_f1
string.value: I cannot change right now, BEEP BEEP. Ask me later.

string.name: c32_f2
string.value: My arm hurts right now. Please grease me up. BEEP BEEP.

string.name: c32_f3
string.value: Master, I don't want to change. Can I go drink some oil? BEEP BEEP?

string.name: c33_s1
string.value: This is always fun! BEEP BEEP!!

string.name: c33_s2
string.value: If you want to learn how to change, just look at me! BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c33_s3
string.value: I've practiced this move for a while! BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c33_f1
string.value: I am not a tramsformer. I am a pet. BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c33_f2
string.value: Grease me up, first, then I'll think about it. BEEP BEEP.

string.name: c33_f3
string.value: Do not assume that all robots change their forms to something new, BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c33_f4
string.value: I prefer keeping myself in this form, BEEP BEEP

string.name: c34_s1
string.value: It's always fun to transform into something completely different~!

string.name: c34_s2
string.value: Call me the transformer, because I am the best you will ever find!

string.name: c34_s3
string.value: Beep beep. I should learn to transform into a car soon.

string.name: c34_s4
string.value: I have mastered the art of transforming! Learn from me!!

string.name: c34_f1
string.value: What am I, your toy? I don't change.

string.name: c34_f2
string.value: My bolts are loose. It may all come off if I change my form right now. Tighten me up! BEEP BEEP!

string.name: c34_f3
string.value: Contrary to popular belief, I do not turn into a car. I'm just a pet!

string.name: c34_f4
string.value: Show me how to turn into a snail. You can't, right? Then don't ask!

string.name: f2_f
string.value: I'm too full. Seriously, don't feed me anymore.

string.name: f3_s
string.value: Ohh, how did you know I was hungry? Great timing, BEEP BEEP!

string.name: f3_f
string.value: Master, I can't eat anymore. Don't make me become fat now.

string.name: f4_s
string.value: Okay, now this is delicious! I was starving, you know!

string.name: s4
string.value: Do not try to offend me! BEEP!!!

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: 주인님 꼭 지금 앉아야 되는 거에요? 멍멍멍~!

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: 여기 너무 지저분해서 앉을수가 없다구요~ 멍멍~

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: 주인님... 아직도 앉는거 시키는 거에요? 너무 쉽다구요.

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: 뒷다리가 너무 짧아서 이렇게 앉아있는게 편해요... 히히...

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: 앉는건 너무 쉽다구요. 좀 더 어려운거 없나요?

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: 크르르르~ 언제까지 참고만 있진 않을거야! 멍멍!

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: 주인님! 그럴수도 있지 뭘 그러세요! 멍멍!

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: 주인님! 심심하다고 혼내는 건 나빠요! 멍멍멍!

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: 이렇게 귀여운 펫이 어딨다구 그러세요! 크르르~!

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: 아이참... 쟤 또 가만히 있는 나한테 괜히 화풀이 하네...

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: 주인님... 살다 보면 그럴수도 있는걸 왜 그러세요~

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: 주인님 너무하세요... 그렇게 심한 말을... 깨갱...

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: 주인님... 저 방금 엄청 상처받았어요... 멍...

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: 그냥 한번 해 본 말이죠? 멍멍~

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: 주인님이 구박해도 전 주인님만 따라다닐 거에요... 흑...

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: 주인님 어떻게 그런 말을... 진심이 아닌거죠?

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: 아이 가려워. 그런 소리 말고 목욕이나 시켜줘요.

string.name: c14_s4
string.value: 헤헤... 밥을 너무 많이 먹었나봐... 멍멍~

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: 주인님... 응가한지 얼마 안 지났어요... 멍...

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: 아직 응가할 시간이 아니에요, 주인님. 멍...

string.name: c16_s1
string.value: 아이 시원하다~ 그래도 응가하는 건 챙피해~ 히히...

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: 끄으응... 앗! 아까 당근을 먹었더니 응가 색깔이...!?!?

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: 비밀이지만... 이 근처에 몰래 뼈다귀를 숨겨놨어. 멍멍~

string.name: c17_s2
string.value: 요즘 유행하는 노래는 뭐가 있어? 멍멍멍???

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: 취미가 뭐야? 나랑 같이 할수 있는거 였으면 좋겠다~ 멍멍~

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: 헤네시스의 숨겨진 곳에서 머쉬맘이라는 엄청 큰 버섯이 나온다며? 멍멍~

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: 가끔은 메뉴좀 바꿔주세요. 너무 똑같은 밥만 먹으니까 싫어요~ 멍멍~

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: 가끔은 배타고 다른 섬으로 놀러가 봤으면 좋겠어요~ 멍멍멍~

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: 오늘 기분은 어떠세요? 좋죠? 그렇죠? 멍멍멍~!

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: 다른 사람과 거래를 할때는 사기 당하지 않게 조심해야 되요. 멍멍~

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: 우울해... 다 귀찮아... 말 안할래... 멍...

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: 오늘의 메뉴는 뭐에요? 기왕이면 맛있는 걸로 부탁해요~

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: 주인님 어째 요즘 배가 나온것 같은데요? 히히...

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: 에이... 말 시키지 말고 밥이나 주지...

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: 아이 참... 또 말하라는 거야? 싫은데~

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: 싫어! 지금은 다른거 하고 싶어! 멍멍!

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: 너 혀 짧지~! 무슨 말인지 모르겠다구! 멍멍!

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: 주인님이 하라는 거라면 뭐든지 할거에요~ 멍멍~

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: 주인님, 이렇게 하면 되는 건가요? 멍멍~

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: 바닥이 너무 더러워서 엎드리기 싫다구요! 멍!!!

string.name: c22_s1
string.value: 이렇게요? 에이... 한 번은 시키는대로 해준다...

string.name: c22_f1
string.value: 주인님! 저도 언제까지 시키는대로만 하지는 않는다구요!

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: 이 짧은 다리로 어떻게 일어서냐! 멍멍멍!

string.name: c24_s2
string.value: 주인님 근데 두 발로 걷는건 못해요~

string.name: c24_s4
string.value: 우와~ 이렇게 짧은 다리로 일어서다니 나도 정말 대단한데~

string.name: c24_f1
string.value: 밥 주면 일어날 수 있을것 같은데... 히히...

string.name: c24_f2
string.value: 이 짧은 다리로는 네 발로 서 있기도 힘들다구...

string.name: c28_f2
string.value: 그냥 해본 말인거 다 아는데 뭘...

string.value: Yeti is scared~ Yeti will be good now~ Grrr

string.value: Grrr~ Yeti does not act angry~ Grr~

string.value: Grr... Yeti is a good Yeti...Grr...

string.value: Yeti is sorry... Yeti feels bad now...Grr..

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: Grr~ If Yeti keeps being scolded, Yeti will feel very lonely~ Grrr...

string.value: Yeti will not be bad from here on out~ Grr

string.value: Yeti will leave~ off to El Nath!!! Grrr~

string.value: Yeti gets angry if scolded~ Yeti likes compliments~ Grrr!!

string.value: Yeti doesn't like being here. Yeti wants to leave!!! Yeti~ Grr!!

string.value: Master, forgive Yeti~ Yeti has been very bad~ Grr~

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Grr~ Yeti doesn't go against master~ Grr~

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: Grr~ Yeti may be scolded, but Yeti still likes the master~

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: Yeti is really feeling awful, and wants to make up for it~ Yeti is really good now!

string.value: Master gets angry at Yeti sometimes! Master is very bad!!Grrr!!

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: Yeti makes mistakes at times, and so does the master~!! Grr!!

string.value: Grr~!! If master keeps getting angry at Yeti, Yeti gets angry at master~

string.value: Yeti is bouncing! Yeti feels good~

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: Grr~ Yeti is a great dancer~ Yeti's great at everything!

string.value: Yeti does not dance in public. Grr~

string.value: Yeti is still a little bit shy~ Grr...

string.value: Yeti feels awesome right now, and the moves are coming out~ Grr!

string.value: Yeti dances like no one else in this world~ Grrr~

string.value: Grr~ Yeti used to be the number 1 dancer in El Nath~ Grr~

string.value: Yeti will show the master how to dance~ This is exactly how you dance~ Grrr~

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: 까칠이에게 예쁨 받고 싶어서 앉는 거 아냐!

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: 까칠이 말 잘들으면 뭐가 좋은데? 우선 말해봐~ 도치~

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: 앉아? 난 3살 때부터 앉다라는 것을 잊어버렸어~!

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: 내가 앉으면 까칠이도 앉아야지! 까칠이가 힘들가봐 앉는거 아냐!

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: 도치~ 도치~ 이쁨 받고 싶어서 이런다고 생각하지마!

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: 까칠~ 내가 앉을거라고 기대하진마! 하지만 난 앉겠어~!

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: 단지 다리가 아파서 앉는 거뿐이야! 까칠이, 착각하지 마!

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: 까칠! 까칠! 이제 내 성격을 알 때가 되지 않았어?

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: 까칠이는 내가 말 잘 듣는 펫이라고 생각해? 그렇다면, 까칠한 착각이야~!

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: 도치! 도치! 정말 지겨워~! 왜 나만 앉으라고 그러는 거야?

string.name: c6_s3
string.value: 내가 까칠하다고......, 까칠이까지 이럴 필요는 없잖아!

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: 흑....... 더 까칠해 질 거야! 까칠~

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: 도치! 내 털이 서 있는거 안 보여?

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: 내가 이런 말을 듣고 살아야 한다니! 까칠!

string.value: 까칠? 그런 말 하지 마! 이젠 말 잘 들을게! 까칠.......

string.value: 미워! 까칠이가 내 마음에 바늘을 꽂았어! 도치!

string.name: c7_f1

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: 왜 날 더 까칠하게 만드니~! 까칠이아~!

string.name: c17_f4

string.value: 까칠이! 항상 예뻐해 주고 사랑해줘서 고맙다고~ 까칠!

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: 도치~ 이제 그만~! 말하는 것도 그만~! 밥도 그만? 그런 안돼!

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: 까칠이가 먼저 고슴도치 언어를 말해봐~! 까칠~

string.value: 까칠~ 까칠이의 마음 정말 고맙다. 까칠~

string.name: c20_s2

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: The fault lies not just with me, but with you as well.

string.name: c24_s3
string.value: I can find it, just bear with me!

string.name: c24_s4
string.value: I think it's over here, wait. Never mind.

string.name: c24_f3
string.value: One does not insult a skunk, for various reasons.

string.name: c25_s2
string.value: There's something around here..I know it!

string.name: c25_s3
string.value: I feel like I'm closing in on something...

string.name: c25_f2
string.value: I feel bad, thanks a lot!

string.name: c25_f4
string.value: It's not easy being me, you could be nicer!

string.name: c26_s1
string.value: Stop. It's not what you think it is.

string.name: c26_f3
string.value: What, may I ask, did you expect?

string.name: c26_f4
string.value: You should try smelling yours one day.

string.name: c27_f1
string.value: You know, your breath isn't exactly 'sweet-smelling' either.

string.name: c27_f2
string.value: I ate snail burgers. Sue me.

string.name: c27_f4
string.value: I do not have bad breath!

string.name: c28_s2
string.value: Ready for a night on the town?

string.name: c28_f1
string.value: Long night last night, so I need rest.

string.name: c29_s4
string.value: Uh, that other Skunk did it.

string.name: c29_f1
string.value: Would you rather have it out here or indoors.

string.name: c29_f2
string.value: And what? Yours smells like roses and chocolate?

string.name: c29_f3
string.value: Contrary to popular belief, yours stink too.

string.name: c30_s4
string.value: Why don't you nap with me?

string.name: c30_f4
string.value: I can go all day and all night!

string.name: c31_s3
string.value: I'm going to get some zzzz.

string.name: c31_f2
string.value: Got to keep an eye out for monsters...

string.name: c31_f3
string.value: The ground is too hard here.

string.name: c31_f4
string.value: It's a bit cold here for me.

string.name: c32_s1
string.value: I guess this is as good a spot as any...

string.name: c33_s3
string.value: I'm the best. You know this.

string.name: c34_s1
string.value: When the going gets tough, the tough call a skunk!

string.name: c34_f2
string.value: Boldness isn't always a strong suit.

string.name: c34_f3
string.value: Stop trying to kiss my tail.

string.name: c34_f4
string.value: So, what are you really after?

string.name: c35_s1
string.value: Hold on, getting some dirt off my shoulder.

string.name: c35_s2
string.value: Remember, you're dealing with the best.

string.name: c35_f1
string.value: Flattery is often seen as a ploy of those with nothing else to offer.

string.name: c35_f2
string.value: There's a point where flattery begins to sound hollow.

string.name: c35_f3
string.value: I don't know what you're after, but you won't get it from me.

string.name: f3_f
string.value: A meal fit for a ruffian. Take it away!

string.name: s2
string.value: Kyuu... I am not gonna say that.

string.name: s3
string.value: I am not the kind of Rabbit who speaks of evil words,~

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: 편안한 의자에 앉아 시원한 주스를~ 아루~

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: 내 가방안에 뭐가 들었는지 알아? 아루~

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: 키노는 편안한 릴렉스 체어에서 쉬고 싶어요~

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: 키노는 주인님과 신나는 모험을 떠나고 싶어요~♬

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: 아루루~ 오늘은 조금 피곤해요. 주인님은 어떠세요?

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: 주인님은 어쩜 그렇게 멋질 수가 있어요?

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: 릴렉스 체어에 앉아서 시원한 주스를 한잔하고 싶어요~

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: 아루~아루루~ 키노는 주인님과 함께 있어서 너~무 행복해요♡

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: 아루! 주인님 제가 재미난 얘기해드릴까요? 호호호 그건 다음에~

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: 고백을 하려면 반짝이는 예쁜 돌이라도 준비했어야죠!

string.name: c22_s2
string.value: 두눈을 꼭 감고 귀를 막아도 주인님만 떠올라요~♡

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: I do this for you, you do something else for me. Deal?

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: I can't hear you. Speak up!

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: I don't understand what you're saying...

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: This is an easy, easy command. Pssh.

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: I was just about to sit, but not because you ordered me to.

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: This is why I carry around a chair at all times.

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: I am not used to sitting around a place like this...

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: Do you think I only do things at your command?

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Have you seen my chair? You know I can't sit without one.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: You know you want to sit, too. Too bad this chair has a weight limit!

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: Hey, I looked up advanced robots online and saw an awesome movie. Did you see it?

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: I'm not trying as tall as you. I'm just...used to sitting here.

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: That was the one command I didn't want to hear today.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: You first. Then I'll think about it.

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: Why don't you go dance with hectors first?

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: Don't tell me to do things I don't want to do!

string.name: c5_f2
string.value: I'm not sleepy. I want to do something else.

string.name: c6_s2
string.value: I'm going to sleep now. See you tomorrow.

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: There's nothing like sleeping at home...

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: Did you secretly upload a sleeping program to my system? Why do I feel so sleepy?

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: I'll need to sleep now. My skin needs it.

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: I don't like sleeping. I like playing with you.

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: It's still bright outside. Why do you want me to sleep?

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: Can we do something other than sleep?

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: I don't want to sleep. I want to play around with you.

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: I'm going to dream about flying tonight! Zzzzzzz

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: Ah, it's time to go to bed already. Good night!

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: I wanted to hang out with you more...but I'm so sleepy...

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: Shhh, I think there's a monster around the area.

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: I need a lullaby to fall asleep...

string.name: c10_s1
string.value: What made you so mad at me?

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: Don't talk like that. I'm scared.

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: Do you really want to yell at me like that?

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: You were going to hit me. Ahhh!!

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: Why do you make me cry?

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: You need to tell me what I did wrong...

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: You're the only one I've got...I feel like crying now.

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: I'll do better next time...but what exactly do I have to do better?

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: Do you have to talk to me like that?

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: Don't let your frustrations out on me. Do it on the monsters!

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: What exactly did I do wrong?

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: You must be bored, aren't you?

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: Hey, I'm the most obedient robot you'll ever find.

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: What are you trying to say?

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: I love you like a computer loves it's monitor.

string.name: c15_s2
string.value: Ahhh... that just made my day.

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: Good, if you want to be in my good graces, this is the way to do it.

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: Wait, can you say that one more time?

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: Hey, a joke is a joke. Make it sound like one.

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: You are NOT the first person to say that... but thanks anyways.

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: It's so hard to be loved by people...I must have a talent for that.

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: You don't need to say that out loud. I know you do.

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: I'm sick of hearing that now. So many people keep telling me they love me.

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: I want to hear that from a hot robot!

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: That's the 234234th time I heard that. Sigh.

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: That's what Bloctopus told me last night.

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: You didn't just say what I think you did...

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: What have I done to deserve this?

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: You seem more stupid than I am...

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: I am not stupid! I am smart!

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: What makes you think you can say that?

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: Keep telling me that, and one day I'll run away!

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: I just saved that in my memory bank. I'll keep that in mind.

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: Can't we just all get along?

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: Look, if I had a single digit IQ, I'd be mad too. It's ok.

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: Ok, genius. What's the last digit of Pi? Thought so...

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: I am much smarter than you.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: Are you having fun tormenting me?

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: Really? Is it really that fun to make fun of me?

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: Why are you doing this to me? I'm nice and good looking.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Even a heart of steel like mine will crack if you keep saying that.

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: I'll hate you for that. Seriously.

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: I'll be better. Don't hate me.

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: I don't feel like doing that.

string.name: c22_s1
string.value: Bring it on! Bring it on!!!

string.name: c22_s3
string.value: I'm ready to fire away! Muahahah!!!

string.name: c22_f2
string.value: Isn't it beautiful outside? Let's walk around.

string.name: c22_f4
string.value: I believe in peace, not war.

string.name: c23_s2
string.value: I'll attack. You go pick up the items.

string.name: c23_s3
string.value: Show me if you can find someone who can shoot better than me!

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: I don't need to aim. I'll just fire away!!!

string.name: c23_f1
string.value: Hmmm...my tail seems to be working well.

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: Lalala! What did you just say?

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: It's so nice outside. Let's go camping!

string.name: c24_s1
string.value: Press 1 to speak to a talking robot, press 0 to repeat the message.

string.name: c24_s2
string.value: Do you think I can meet up with other robots like me at Ludibrium?

string.name: c24_s3
string.value: What's the tallest tower in the world? Eos Tower, of course!

string.name: c24_s4
string.value: I think I am by far the best looking robot here...

string.name: c24_f1
string.value: Do you need someone to talk to?

string.name: c24_f2
string.value: I don't think I can talk to you...

string.name: c25_s1
string.value: Do you want to know how smart I am? Much smarter than you!!

string.name: c25_s2
string.value: Any hot robots around here? I can't find any...

string.name: c25_s3
string.value: I am so lonely. Introduce me to other robots!!!

string.name: c25_s4
string.value: Dragon Roar!!!! Wait, why can't I do this?

string.name: c25_f2
string.value: I'm sorry I only have one mouth to speak.

string.name: c25_f3
string.value: I can't express myself with words...

string.name: c26_s1
string.value: Promise me to show me if you ever run across an amazing part for robots!

string.name: c26_s2
string.value: A few days ago, I saw this incredible thing that's covered in gold light. He seemed quite familiar...

string.name: c26_s3
string.value: I talked to Jr. Balrog yesterday, and he wanted to have a word with you...alone.

string.name: c26_s4
string.value: Arwen, Rowen, and Mar are in a love triangle. Why? Because of me!!!

string.name: c26_f1
string.value: Did I sleep too late last night? I'm tired.

string.name: c26_f2
string.value: Arwen said she likes quiet men.

string.name: c26_f3
string.value: Did I talk too much today? I feel like my wires have burnt out for the day.

string.name: c26_f4
string.value: Let's stop talking and start hunting.

string.name: c27_s1
string.value: Just tell me where the monsters are.

string.name: c27_s4
string.value: How about transforming in the morning, afternoon, and nighttime?

string.name: c27_f2
string.value: I don't feel like doing that.

string.name: c27_f3
string.value: This isn't fun. I don't want to do it.

string.name: c28_s1
string.value: Now transforming to the hottest robot in this world.

string.name: c28_s2
string.value: I deal with the monsters. You deal with the items.

string.name: c28_s3
string.value: Size has nothing to do with power.

string.name: c28_f2
string.value: You know, I can't do EVERYTHING for you.

string.name: c28_f3
string.value: I don't care if you call me a bad robot.

string.name: c28_f4
string.value: I say no to anyone that orders me to do something.

string.name: c29_s1
string.value: Now transforming to the most powerful, spectacular, amazing, sexiest robot ever!

string.name: c29_s2
string.value: I bet you no one else can do this!

string.name: c29_s3
string.value: Now transforming to...Meso Rangers!!! Wait, that's not it.

string.name: c29_s4
string.value: More than meets the--wait...I can't say that!

string.name: c29_f1
string.value: I don't think you realize just how hard it is to transform.

string.name: c29_f3
string.value: Dude...do you want eat some of this iron fists?

string.name: c29_f4
string.value: Do you realize how stupid I feel firing away at nothing?

string.name: f1_f
string.value: What are you trying to do?

string.name: f2_f
string.value: My batteries have been charged already.

string.name: f3_s
string.value: I am at my happiest eating.

string.name: f3_f
string.value: It's not time to charge batteries yet!

string.name: f4_s
string.value: How did you know I was so hungry?

string.name: f4_f
string.value: I know I can eat a lot, but not THAT much.

string.name: s4
string.value: If you say bad words, I am gonna ban you!

string.name: e_levelup
string.value: Congratulations! You're still a long way from my level, though!

string.name: e_rest
string.value: Are you bored? What are you doing?

string.name: e_HPAlert
string.value: I think I saw something blink...hey, are you alright?

string.name: e_prelevelup
string.value: A little more, and you'll level up! Keep going!

string.name: e_NOHPPotion
string.value: I don't have any HP potions to give you. Check your inventory.

string.value: I don't have any MP potions to give you. Check your inventory.
You don't look too good... maybe you should change your skin color.
It's time for a phone call from my lover #23.
It's time for a phone call from my lover #234.
It's time for a phone call from my lover #2567.
My goal is to make 10,000 lovers. You?
Would it look weird if I wear an earring?
Hey what's the most popular style in Henesys these days? Don't tell me it's what you're wearing...
Do you understand how many dates I have to decline in order to be with you?
I only talk to you so you won't get too bored.
Hey, whatever I told you right now is a secret, okay?
I like hanging out with you!
Why do women love small, shiny objects?
Don't you remember struggling against snails?
We've been walking too much. Let's go to Aqua Road and rest.
If you know any nice restaurants, take me there!

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: Kling klang! At your command, master.

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: Kling klang! Just input the right command, and I'll do the rest.

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: Perfect command. You are a computer master! Kling klang!

string.name: c2_f1
string.value: Beep beep! An error has occurred.

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: Kling klang! I won't site until you sit first.

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: An error has occurred! Please double check the command. Beep! Beep!

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: "Sit" is such a great keyword for all pets... Kling klang!

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: Oh oops! I almost farted while sitting down. Kling klang!

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: You know exactly what I want. I really wanted to sit right now...

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: Hmmm...an important program that lets me sit is corrupt. I can't do it..heh

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: I want to talk today, master, beep beep!

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Beep beep! Grrr...I can't move right now due to an error.

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: Make me move first. I don't see a lot of effort on your part.

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: Ahhhh!! I almost cramped up my legs.

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: Like this? Precise commands yield smart pets like me.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: I feel too weak to stand.

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: You just told me to sit. Jeez! Make up your mind!

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: How many times do I have to tell you? You're saying it all wrong!

string.name: c5_s3
string.value: I'm in tip top shape right now. I'll follow your command.

string.name: c5_f2
string.value: Beep beep beep...ahh I gotta just sit.

string.name: c5_f3
string.value: My body's not functioning right today. Just let it go.

string.name: c6_s2
string.value: Master, you have been verified! Will stand now!

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: Are you my master? Enter your ID and PW.

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: Are you trying to get another pet with a different color? I can read your mind, you know.

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: Due to system overload, I cannot process commands for the rest of the day. Time for me to rest.

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: I want love and affection from my master. What's wrong with you?

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: You are a bigger dummy than I am.

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: Who? What? What did you say?

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: If you say so...then it is so...

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: I am a fool for your love, master.

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: I don't understand what you're saying.

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: Now you're saying this. Do I look that easy?

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: Unrecognizable word. I don't know what you're talking about.

string.name: c9_s2
string.value: I may be dumb, but I still follow your commands.

string.name: c9_s3
string.value: If I got fixed on time...I'd be the best robot in this world.

string.name: c9_s4
string.value: Stupid...? What do I need, a virus scan? Run it right now!

string.name: c9_f1
string.value: Master, you must be afraid of me.

string.name: c9_f2
string.value: First time hearing it. I can't find the resulting value for that command.

string.name: c9_f3
string.value: If you don't like me... then oh well, good riddance.

string.name: c9_f4
string.value: An error has occurred. Please leave. Beep beep!

string.name: c10_s1
string.value: What did I do wrong...? Shooooo...

string.name: c10_s2
string.value: I won't do that again. Please love me. Shooooo...

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: I'm sorry. I'll be better next time. Shooooo...

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: I'm only doing this to catch your attention. Shoooo...

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: What did you just say? I didn't do anything wrong!

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: My ears hurt... Stop nagging on me, master!!!

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: I hate you! You keep ragging on me for no reason!

string.name: c10_f4
string.value: Is that some foreign language? I don't understand a word of what you're saying...

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: I'm sorry...I didn't do that on purpose.

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: Are you really mad? I'm sorry...

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: Are you messing with me? What did I do wrong?

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: So you're in a bad mood...that doesn't mean you can go off on me like that!

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: I have no idea what you're saying right now.

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: I did nothing wrong! It's all you!!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: That was my bad. I won't ever do that again.

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: I'll do better now. Please don't hate me!

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: Are you just trying to pick something with me?

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: Master, you need to loosen up a bit!

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: Seriously, it's really not that serious.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: I was trying to apologize, but I don't like your attitude.

string.name: c13_s2
string.value: Don't you like how I do all this for you?

string.name: c13_s3
string.value: Wow, you really want to hold my hand?

string.name: c13_f1
string.value: Hands? I only have feet... Shoooo...

string.name: c13_f2
string.value: Do I have to give you my hand when you're asking for it? Nah...

string.name: c13_f3
string.value: Are you trying to play rock paper and scissors?

string.name: c14_s1
string.value: Am I sweet or what? Love me!!!

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: Master, aren't you the nice one!

string.name: c14_s4
string.value: Here...I think my right hand looks better than left.

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: You don't even help me get a pedicure on my nails.

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: Here! Please help me get a pedicure.

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: I'm sleepy...why are you asking this to me?

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: I know what you mean. I understand...

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: You were scolding me just now, and now you love me? Whatever.

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: Have you been secretly liking me for a while?

string.value: Lala... My heart is yours as well!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: I hope that your heart shall never change.

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: I will stand by you always!

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: I will overcome our differences, to stand by you!

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: I shall be returning to my kingdom soon.

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: We are of different classes. I am sorry.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: Did you at least bring me some sugar cubes?

string.name: c13_s4
string.value: If that is what you desire...

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: I am a prince, but I can be down to earth! Hrrgh!

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: No, this is not right! Not right at all!

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: I hope that you will learn to be a bit more elegant.

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: Phhhhhhrt... You didn't hear that! It wasn't me!

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: Unicorns are too dignified for pooping.

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: I am no commoner. How can I go in such a place as this?

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: My leavings are not for all to see!

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: You should get some rest too.

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: I am find just as I am!

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: You need to move around more. Look at your love handles!

string.name: c17_s2
string.value: Posture is important, even when sleeping...zzz...

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: So, this is how the homeless sleep...

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: Can you even think of sleeping at your level?

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: Why don't you prepare a nice bed for me first?

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: Aah...I miss my golden bed back in the castle.

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: I am not used to taking orders!

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: I wish for my kingdom to appear in my dreams.

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: We have much to do. There is no time for sleeping!

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: How dare you try to command me!

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: Bring me some sugar cubes! I am hungry!

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: Lala...I am the first prince of the Unicorn Kingdom!

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: I have come here just to meet you.

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: Dignity and elegance are my pride and calling.

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: I shall invite you to my kingdom someday.

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: Lala... Let us sing a song!

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: My sister is a beautiful unicorn with a light blue mane.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: Esel and I are good friends.

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: I hope that my sister will be able to visit Maple World.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Esel and I still feel quite...lonely.

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: Members of the royal family like myself must be careful in all that we say and do!

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: It wasn't a mistake that brought me to Maple World.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: My kingdom is inhabited by only unicorns.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: Do you wish to learn some manners from me?

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: Elegant unicorns such as myself enjoy silence.

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: What? You surprised me. I wasn't expecting you to talk to me.

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: I'm in no mood to talk.

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: There are days when i just feel like being alone. Alone!

string.name: c22_s3
string.value: It is not for anyone to see.

string.name: c22_s4
string.value: If I don't move for 10 minutes, call a doctor.

string.name: c22_f1
string.value: How dare you command a member of the royal family!

string.name: c22_f2
string.value: I refuse! How can an unicorn of my stature stoop so low?

string.name: c22_f3
string.value: Wehee! How dare you try to command me?

string.name: c22_f4
string.value: I am too tired for a trick!

string.name: c23_s1
string.value: I shall show you something that Esel can't even attempt!

string.name: c23_s2
string.value: This is a secret move, passed down through the royal family.

string.name: c23_s3
string.value: Aah...I don't think I can perform that today!

string.name: c23_f1
string.value: How can you ask me to do such a thing? I cannot!

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: I am too tired. Please bring me a sugar cube.

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: Wehee. It's not something you can see anytime you want to!

string.name: f2_f
string.value: I am quite full! Please, no more!

string.name: f3_f
string.value: Aah...I miss the meals back in my kingdom..

string.name: s3
string.value: A beautiful word for a beautiful person...

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: I sit on ground for now.

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: You no want I steal gold? I steal good, Mr'kuma.

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: Don't wanna! I wanna set your hair on fire!

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Sit? Me not know word. Hehehe...

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: Okay, human. You tell me when we are going to eat monsters again.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I will sit for you, Mr'kuma. You are scary and powerful!

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: I do as you say, for now...

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: Later, you sit and I get to burn houses down!

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: No way! I am not your kr'grana!

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: I don't wanna! I am mighty and full of fangs!

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: Rak! Why you always want to sit?!

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: You take me to lake of fire first!

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: My old boss was scary too. He eat my brother! So fun!

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: You scare many monsters with your talk! Scare me a little too...

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: No talk to me like kr'gana. Me much strong!

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: Rak unar! I eat your wallet tonight!

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: I like it when you are angry, Mr'kuma. I will be angry too!

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Yes! Let's find some little kids to yell at!

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: Everytime you yell, I feel a little more at home...

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: Ha! More! Tell me how worthless I am!

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: You always say the same insults. Think up something new!

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: I know you can do better than that, Mr'kuma.

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: I know you have more rage in you than that...

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: I don't want to be flattered right now!

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: Why you talk like wimp, Mr'kuma?

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: Grauk-mouthed unar! You think I simple?!

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: I no fall for trick. Old Mr'kuma trick me like this long ago.

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: Hand over wallet, Mr'kuma. You go crazy in your mind.

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: I come back when you not trying to eat me.

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: You are the cruelest of all masters...and I like it.

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: Are you mad at me because I tortured your goldfish? He was asking for it!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: That is the rudest thing you can say in demon culture!

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: Now I see you are just trying to be mean to me. Thank you, Mr'kuma!

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: There is no such thing as love.

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: My heart is cold and black like a piece of coal!

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: I'm almost getting used to this constant abuse.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: You're just trying to make me get mad again.

string.value: Why say word "poop" all time, Mr'aku?

string.value: You like drakla so much? I give to you.

string.value: I not eat enough monster today!

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: You no treasure drakla. It MY drakla!

string.value: Master, you love pooping as much as I do!

string.value: I bet I can burn a hole in the ground with this one...

string.value: I love stinking up your fresh air, Mr'kuma.

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: Empty out everything, master. Even your soul!

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: I'll let go of this poop when I darn well feel like it.

string.value: My bottom still hurts from the last one.

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: I have got to stop eating so many spicy monsters.

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: I know better than to trust you.

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: Hey, can you beat Pink Bean?

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: You better play some Gachapon today, cause I'm feeling lucky!

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: I heard there's something scary in a cave in Leafre!

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: Let's put the talk aside, it's time to get some food to eat! POOOF!

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: You must be really bored aren't you? Pooooofff!

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: Arrgh...didn't hear a thing...didn't hear a thing...

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: Sometime butterflies do have our OFF day!

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: You sure you are not lying?

string.name: c22_s1
string.value: That's so sweet! I LOVE YOU TOO! Pooooooof!

string.name: c22_s2
string.value: Thanks thanks! I love you too! Poooooof!

string.name: c22_s3
string.value: I guess I am starting to fall in love with you too! Pooooof!

string.name: c22_s4
string.value: I like you very very much! Poooof!

string.name: c22_f3
string.value: That came as a surprise! I am experiencing butterflies in my stomach now!

string.name: c23_s1
string.value: Catch this cupid's arrow from me to you! Pooooof!

string.name: c23_s2
string.value: My heart will go on and on for you, pooooof!

string.name: c23_s3
string.value: ORLY? I LOVE YOU TOO! Pooooof!

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: You don't really see a butterfly blush don't you? I am blushing now!

string.name: c23_f1
string.value: Quit playing games with my heart! Poooof!

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: You gotta lay off those gummi bears!

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: Don't say you love me, you don't even know me! clickkk clickkk!

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: Time to grab some bites! Poooof!

string.name: c24_s1
string.value: Time to sleep in my cosy leaf bed! Will you hug me to sleep tonight?

string.name: c24_s3
string.value: Hold me tight in your arms! Clickkk Clickkk!

string.name: c24_s4
string.value: Don't let the bed bugs bite! Hehe!

string.name: c24_f1
string.value: Let's go for some late night! I am not sleepy!

string.name: c24_f2
string.value: Sing me a lullaby and I will go to my wonderland!

string.name: c24_f3
string.value: Let me dance with the moon and stars tonight!

string.name: c24_f4
string.value: I can't sleep cause I am dreaming of something...

string.name: c25_s1
string.value: Let the power of the butterflies transform!

string.name: c25_s2
string.value: Time to transform into a Monster Moth!

string.name: c25_f1
string.value: Can't just do it all the time, you know.

string.name: c25_f2
string.value: I can't just do it anywhere.

string.name: c25_f3
string.value: Too much only spoils the fun.

string.name: c25_f4
string.value: Let's just sit and relax, shall we?

string.name: f2_f
string.value: I have to stop eating now! Arghhh!

string.name: f3_s
string.value: You're really good at it aren't you?

string.name: f3_f
string.value: I'm too full to eat anymore!

string.name: s2
string.value: Why are you aking me to say that kind of words? Clickkk clickkkkk~

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: Or we could do something else…

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Do you hear yourself? All these commands…

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: Check it out… Pretty good, right?

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: Ahh... I'm sleepy… Can't hear you…

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: Sitting's waaay too easy… I'm feeling underutilized here.

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: I was just minding my own business... then this! Squerch!

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: Why do you do this? Squerch?

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: I know squerch kwon do and I WILL use it! Squerch!

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: You're not really mad, right? Right?

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: Some masters let their pets have fun…

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: I looked up some other masters… Turns out there are plenty of options.

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: I promise I'll be good now…

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: I haven't done anything wrong, and still...

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: Is there a reason for this or do you just like yelling?

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: I'm so used to it, I don't even feel it anymore...

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: Master gets bored, so I get yelled at…

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: It's not pooping time yet. Squerch.

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: How can I poop if you don't feed me? Squerch.

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: Pooping is only for the bathroom. Squerch.

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: Oooh... I almost stepped in it...

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: It hasn't been long enough yet, master.

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: Not really into pooping on command…

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: When do I get to tell YOU to poop, master?

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: Ahh... whoa, my breakfast just came out like that...

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: Phew! Doesn't my poop look as adorable as me?

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: Phew... You can tell it's been a while! Yowza!

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: I don't have anything to poop out in the first place!

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: I'm saving it all for one big poop.

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: Did you just say what I think you said? Squerch.

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: I think I love you too!

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: And you just had to tell me?

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: Ah... I thought you were going to say something else…

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: That was a good one... haha...

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: You're the only one in my heart, master!

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: You're making my gills red, master...

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: Oh! Oh!! Me too! Me too!! hehe...

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: Probably should have kept that one to yourself…

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: You'll have to do better than that…

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: You want me to fake it? Squerch.

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: Have you seen a shark smile? Not pretty. Squerch.

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: How about a treat instead? Squerch.

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: I'll do whatever you ask me to do, master!

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: I'm already smiling… Cause I'm with you!

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: I only open my mouth for food.

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: Not really feeling the whole happiness thing right now…

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: Now you're in charge of my emotions too?

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: Maybe if there's a reward involved.

string.name: c22_s1
string.value: How can you say such thing... Squerch.

string.name: c23_s1
string.value: M... master… I can't believe you said that…

string.name: c23_s2
string.value: That was a joke… right? Right?

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: Master, I get hurt when you say that…

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: And the meanest master of the year award goes to…

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: I see why it's hard for you to make friends.

string.name: c24_s2
string.value: Do you really not like me?

string.name: c24_s3
string.value: You say this all the time. Maybe I'm doing something wrong.

string.name: c24_f1
string.value: Wah? What? I can't hear you.

string.name: c24_f3
string.value: Say it again. See what happens.

string.name: c24_f4
string.value: I'm sick of you berating me!

string.name: c25_s2
string.value: The more you go hunting, the better the items you'll find. Squerch.

string.name: c25_s3
string.value: Isn't it nice out here today? We should go somewhere to play! Squerch.

string.name: c25_s4
string.value: I need a nap on top of a comfortable blanket. Squerch.

string.name: c25_f1
string.value: Have you ever heard of a chatty shark? Squerch.

string.name: c25_f2
string.value: I have nothing to say to you… Squerch…

string.name: c25_f4
string.value: I can't talk to you right now. Squerch.

string.name: c26_s1
string.value: I have a feeling a nice item may come our way today!

string.name: c26_s2
string.value: Master, you'll get me some good food today, right?

string.name: c26_s3
string.value: How are you today? Good? Good!

string.name: c26_s4
string.value: A lot of people are here, so make sure to be courteous!

string.name: c26_f1
string.value: I don't have anything to say…

string.name: c26_f2
string.value: Not much goin on over here…

string.name: c27_s2
string.value: Master, are you dating someone? I just met someone. Maybe we could go on a double date?

string.name: c27_s3
string.value: Master, you have a huge head… hahaha. HUGE!

string.name: c27_f1
string.value: This is boring… I need something more exciting

string.name: c27_f4
string.value: Why do you keep talking to me? I'm trying to sleep...

string.name: c28_s1
string.value: Buurrrrpp. Don't I look cute burping? Squerch.

string.name: c28_s2
string.value: My friends tell me the same thing! Squerch.

string.name: c28_s3
string.value: This is my area of expertise. Squerch.

string.name: c28_f1
string.value: You don't have to tell me that…

string.name: c28_f2
string.value: That doesn't mean much coming from you.

string.name: c28_f3
string.value: Whoa, master must have gone nuts.

string.name: c29_s1
string.value: So you want me to burp? Burrrrrpppp. What do you think?

string.name: c29_s3
string.value: You won't find a cuter pet anywhere! Squerch.

string.name: c29_s4
string.value: Master, what do you think? Cute, right? Squerch!

string.name: c29_f1
string.value: Master! Just get me some food! Squerch!

string.name: c29_f2
string.value: I don't wanna do cute stuff! Squerch!

string.name: c30_s1
string.value: Like this? At least you know a cute act when you see one...

string.name: c30_s2
string.value: Here's a nice gassy burp for you!

string.name: c30_s3
string.value: No one can match my burping skills!

string.name: c30_f1
string.value: You think I'll just do whatever you ask… I thought you were smarter.

string.name: c30_f2
string.value: I need to eat in order to burp, you know...

string.name: c30_f3
string.value: I ate onions and garlic just now... no burping! No cuteness!

string.name: c30_f4
string.value: How do I put this… No?

string.name: c31_s1
string.value: I'm tired. I need to sleep. Squerch...

string.name: c31_s2
string.value: So sleepy... let me sleep... squerch...

string.name: c31_f1
string.value: How am I going to sleep if I'm not even tired! Squerch!

string.name: c32_s3
string.value: Don't go eat something good while I'm asleep! Squerch.

string.name: c32_f2
string.value: So you can doodle on my fins? No thanks!

string.name: c32_f3
string.value: I'm hungry! Can't sleep! Feed me!

string.name: f2_f
string.value: I am about to blow up... squerch...

string.name: f3_s
string.value: Master, this is so delicious... squerch!!!

string.name: f4_s
string.value: This is as good as it gets!

string.name: f4_f
string.value: Are you trying to kill me, master?

string.name: s2
string.value: Squerch? You asking doesn't always mean me doing…

string.name: s3
string.value: Squerch! My precious mouth will not spit those venomous words!

string.name: s4
string.value: Please, no... no flavors like that... Squerch.

string.name: c2_s1
string.value: I'm a nice lamb that obeys well!

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: I was going to sit, baa!

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: I was actually planning to rest, baa!

string.name: c2_f1
string.value: I'm going to play more, baa!

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: Baa baa, you should sit down too.

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: Baa baa? What did you say?

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: I can't hear you, I can't hear you, baa baa!

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: I'm going to fly around more, baa baa!

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: Should we rest a bit? Baa baa.

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: Baa baa! What a peaceful feeling!

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: Baa baa? Are you talking to me?

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: I don't hear anything, baa baa!

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: Baa? What's with you all of sudden?

string.name: c6_s3
string.value: Baah! (It appears to be calling its mother...)

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: Baa! Don't do this to me...

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: Baa... maybe I should change owners.

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: I don't even wanna hear it...

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: Baa baa! It's all my fault!

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: Baa! Did I really mess up that badly?

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: Baa... I won't do that again...

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: Hmph, I'll be the bigger ram.

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: My patience has limits, baa baa.

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: Are you going to keep this up, baa?

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: If only I had a nicer owner...

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Why do you always yell at me... *Cries*

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: I'm going to tell my mommy, baa baa...

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: Wahhhh! You're just mean because you're bigger than me!

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: I really wish I could just smack you, baa baa.

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: I'm gonna call animal protective services!

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: I can get scary when I'm angry, baa...

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: Baa baa... THAT does it! (Veins popping.)

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: Baa baa! I like, I like!

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: I like you very much also!

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: Baa baa. You aren't supposed to joke around like that.

string.name: c10_f4
string.value: Treat me well when you have the chance, baa.

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: Baa! I'm always on your side!

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: I said... I can't hear you!

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: Baa Baa! I got it, I got it!

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: Baa! I love hanging out with you!

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: Baa! Affectionate actions make Pufframs dance!

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: Baa baa. I already know your feelings.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: So what do you want me to do, baa baa?

string.name: c13_f2
string.value: I'm shocked, I don't even have words.

string.name: c13_f3
string.value: (Little veins are popping out on its forehead.)

string.name: c13_f4
string.value: Do you KNOW what you are saying?

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: Something needs to go in for something to come out!

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: Baa baa! Every day is a healthy day!!

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: It's not going to come out just because you whine!

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: Baa... let's have some common sense, shall we?

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: Baa baa... You want to get smacked?

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: I'll let you off for today...

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: No! I want to play more!

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: I want to play more, baa baa!

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: Baa... someday I'll soar higher than a dragon. Baa...

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: Can't you see that my eyes are still WIDE open?

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: Baa baa? What are you saying?

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: I'm not that lazy, baa baa.

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: Baa Baa! So today, I'm going to... (Now it won't stop talking.)

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: Are you amazed by flying lambs? So the secret of our race is...

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: Maple World is a pretty nice place to live, baa baa.

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: When we were living up in the sky, angels mistook us for clouds.

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: Is it strange that I talk?

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: Baa? Weren't we talking just a second ago?

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: Have you every had a Cloud Candy? It's the baaaaa-st.

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: If there's one thing I hate, it's wolves.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: We are called Pufframs because we live above the clouds.

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: Baa baa... just leave me alone...

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: I don't want to talk right now, baa.

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: Mmm... are you hungry for a conversation?

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: Baa baa, would it be better to walk or fly?

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: Baa baa, you want to hear something interesting?

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: Which one of us do you think can fly faster? Me or the eagle?

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: To the Pufframs, the Golden Horn is a symbol of adulthood.

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: You look bored... too bad I'm not!

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: (It appears to be thinking about something.)

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: What if I say no, baa baa?

string.name: c22_s3
string.value: This is the Puffram booty dance!!

string.name: c22_f2
string.value: Am I in the circus or something, baa baa?

string.name: c22_f3
string.value: Baa baa... I said, it sounds annoying...

string.name: c22_f4
string.value: I actually have this super cool trick... but I don't feel like it right now.

string.name: c23_s1
string.value: (Jumps up and down.) Baa! Baa! Baa! Baa!

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: It's super fun when you do it above the clouds, baa baa.

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: Can't I just be your pet?

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: Too hungry... no strength... baa baa.

string.name: f3_s
string.value: Baa baa, eating time's my favorite time!!

string.name: s2
string.value: You want to get reported, baa baa?

string.name: s4
string.value: I'm so disappointed in you, baa baa!!

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: Why should I listen to you?

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: Do I look like a dog to you? Sit, indeed!

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: Yes, perhaps I shall rest my wings. RAWK!!

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: Who are you to order me around? Hm?

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: Birds can't sit, you featherless buffoon!

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: I'm sitting already! I'm sitting RIGHT NOW!

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: Yes, yes, what is it?! I swear, if you tell me to sit one more time...

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: I would be DELIGHTED if you joined me! Don't you have a chair?

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: Very well. But what's this? No cushion?

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: You dare tell me to sit? RAWK!

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Where shall I sit? On your shoulder? Or on your head?

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: The dictionary defines 'sit' as resting with the torso vertical and the body supported on the buttocks. Correct?

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: Yes, it's nice to sit with my intellectual equal. RAWK!

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: Yes, I am quite tired. We've been on a long journey, and I fear I've talked myself into a stupor. RAWK!

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: Why do you insist I sit?

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: Don't you know any other commands?!

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: No. No, that's quite all right. Rawk!

string.name: c6_s1
string.value: Perhaps I was bad. But you'll hear no apology from me!

string.name: c6_s3
string.value: Of course. It won't happen again. Whatever you say.

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: What can I say? My apologies.

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: What is the meaning of this? Unbelievable...

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: I've nothing to say to a tyrant like you!

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: How does throwing a temper tantrum help anything?

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: There's no need to be so forceful.

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: I understand. But is this really my fault?

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: I'll hear you out. What did I do wrong this time?

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: Rawk! Do you want an apology?

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: If you can explain to me what I did wrong, I will be more than happy to apologize.

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Perhaps what I did was wrong, but will an apology REALLY make you feel better?

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: I know what I did was wrong! I don't need you to remind me.

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: Yes, I'm a bad parrot. Does that make you feel better?

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: I have nothing to say to you. RAWK!

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: I don't know what you're talking about, and I don't care!

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: Think this over. Don't you value our friendship? RAWK!

string.name: c10_s1
string.value: Love, love. Such a sweet word!

string.name: c10_s2
string.value: You like me? You really like me?

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: Is your love true? Oh, who cares!

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: I'd blush, but parrots can't blush...

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: Sorry, but my heart belongs to a little parakeet in Henesys.

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: But what will the other parrots think?

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: The love between parrot and master is forever!

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: Is it the color of my feathers that did it? Or the manly shape of my beak?

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: Sh, keep your voice down! You're embarrassing me...

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: Caaan you feeel the love tooooday...

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: No! I won't let you break this parrot heart!

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: Sure, you say that now, but isn't this just a flight of fancy?

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: My melancholy heart, once dark like Kerning City's nighttime sky, is brightened by your affection! CRAAAAW!!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: Yes! Very good! Let's have fun! RAWK!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: Thank you. Not that I feel the same way, but it's nice to hear.

string.name: c12_f1
