string.name: c8_s2
string.value: I haven't felt this bad since I ate that priest.

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: I find you strangely terrifying, mortal.

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: I have shamed a thousand generations of my ancestors.

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: But I have done everything you asked!

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: You are the most fickle mortal I've ever met.

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: You are adorable when you are angry.

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: Find something else to yell at!

string.name: c9_s2
string.value: I hope you do not come to harm.

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: Aren't you supposed to be trembling in fear?

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: I will not be talked down to!

string.name: c10_f4
string.value: You are making my scales itch.

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: Why do my cheeks feel warm? WHAT HAVE YOU DONE TO ME?!

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: My heart thumps when you say these measly words!

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: I believe you mortals would say, "ditto".

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: My dragon heart is not to be trifled with.

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: Do not say anything you will regret.

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: I, uh, have to wash my scales tonight.

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: Hey, how about those Green Mushrooms? Very green, aren't they?

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: Would you like me to take you flying?

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: I will move the heavens for you!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: Might a humble dragon receive a kiss?

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: Are mortal affections given so freely?

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: I am sure you say this to all your pets.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: Who needs love when you have power?!

string.name: c13_s2
string.value: My eyes may be closed, but I have the reflexes of a water dragon!

string.name: c13_s3
string.value: I was already going to do that.

string.name: c13_f1
string.value: Perhaps you'll think of a better wish later.

string.name: c13_f2
string.value: Grawr! It is not my nap time!

string.name: c13_f4
string.value: I have little need for such things.

string.name: c14_s1
string.value: I suppose I could use a recharge.

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: We mighty dragons have no need for sleep!

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: This place is not fit for my great slumber!

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: I am no cat, content to lie in the sun!

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: May I rest upon your lap? This cloud is quite cold.

string.name: c15_s2
string.value: Oh, the dreams I will have!

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: Your wish is granted, mortal! Zzzzzz

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: What if I were to eat you in my sleep?

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: This area is too loud! My dragon ears are sensitive.

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: Can't we go battle some monsters?

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: I JUST drank some dragon coffee!

string.name: c16_s1
string.value: Allow me to fill in your pitiful knowledge of dragons...

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: I was once a mere thunder lizard, until I caught this orb.

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: Do know you how luck you are? Let me tell you.

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: If that is what you wish...

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: I did not descend from the heavens to banter!

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: Your world is teeming with life.

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: My mane is made of the finest spun gold.

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: I am omnipotent and all powerful, but I do get a little lonely.

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: Hold on, let me see if I have anything...NO.

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: Why do you waste my power?

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: Your enormous head must be quite a burden.

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: Does this orb make my tail look fat?

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: All behold the glory of my master and its silly face!

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: My wisdom sounds much better in the original Dragon.

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: What do you want to talk about?

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: Do the powers of the gods so amuse you?

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: This show of force is quite exhausting.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: Grawr! Look at all these lightning bolts!

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: My thunder will break the heavens!

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: This is no mere trick! This is an event!

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: I tire of these petty displays.

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: Have you nothing better to wish for?!

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: I will sink through my cloud if I eat another bite!

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: I try to say no, but my belly continues to rumble.

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: No more, I have much...um...business to attend to.

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: Truly you are a great chef, master!

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: Do not look upon me. I am such a fat dragon...

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: You will not be my master forever...

string.name: c22
string.value: I do not comprehend your ridiculous ways.

string.name: c22_s1
string.value: I WILL eat you. You are but a worm in my eyes.

string.name: c22_s2
string.value: Do not curse the commander of lightning!

string.name: c22_s4
string.value: My real form is scary, Mr'kuma!

string.name: c22_f2
string.value: You do trick. I want laugh when you fall.

string.name: c22_f4
string.value: I show you already! You have bad brain!

string.name: c23_s1
string.value: What if I did this at your next surprise party?

string.name: c23_s2
string.value: Let's go scare some little girls with this trick!

string.name: c23_s3
string.value: With this power, I could conquer all of you puny humans.

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: Bask in awe, master! I am a being of pure terror!

string.name: c23_f1
string.value: How about I torch all your underwear instead?

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: Are you sure? You can never unsee it.

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: Shouldn't we be undermining somebody's hope?

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: I'll eat your eyebrows if you tell me that again!

string.name: f4_f
string.value: What are you trying to do to me?!

string.name: s3
string.value: Old boss call me that. He so cool.

string.name: s4
string.value: Hey! Even we demons have some etiquette.

string.name: c2_s1
string.value: So I sit like this? Peng?

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: Peeng? I sat like you told me to!

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: Are you worried that my feet are tired?

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: Show me how to do it! Peeng!

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: I have to sit on this bare ground? Peng?

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: You sit down too, master! You look tired! Peng!

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: It's a good thing my butt is so fluffy! Peng peng!

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: Peng, thank you master! I was actually kinda tired.

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: Ah, it feels like I came to a picnic! Peng peng!

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: I'm gonna look like a cushion if I sit... peng peng...

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: My legs aren't even hurting... do I really have to sit? Peng?

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: I don't want to sit unless it's on your lap... Peeng...

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: My legs are too short... Peng...

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: Now that I sat down, I feel sleepy... peng...

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I'll do whatever you tell me to!

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: I was actually feeling a bit tired! Peng!

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: Peng peng! You sit down and rest too!

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: Sitting makes my belly look fat.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: Right now, I feel more comfortable standing! Peng!

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: Once I sit, it will be hard to get up, peng...

string.name: c6_s1
string.value: Hearing that from you hurts my feelings. Peng.

string.name: c6_s2
string.value: Peeng... I didn't do it on purpose...

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: I didn't think it will make you angry. Peeng...

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: Peeng? I don't get what I did wrong?

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: Peeng! But I told you that I didn't mean to!

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: Are you just taking your anger out on me? Peng peng!

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: You're scolding me for eating too much, aren't you? Peng peng!

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: Don't get angry. I won't do it again... peng peng...

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: I just did that to get your attention!

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: Peeng... I'll be careful from now on...

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: Peng peng! I didn't do anything wrong.

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: It's hard to understand your words! Peng peng!

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: Peng! You're a real jerk sometimes!

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: A-are you gonna throw me away? Peng...

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Peeng. Hearing that makes me so sad.

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: I bet you're saying that for my own good.

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: I learned it from watching you!

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: Peeng! I hate it when you get mad for no reason.

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: Peeng! Sometimes I just want to fly away!

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: Peng! When I met you, it was love at first sight!

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: That was a really bad joke, peng peng.

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: I'll pretend I didn't hear that, master... peeng...

string.name: c10_f4
string.value: I know what you feel, but that's just... peng...

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: I was waiting for those words! Peng peng!

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: I'll give you a smooch anytime! Peng peng peng!

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: Peng... this is a little weird, but I like it.

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: Peng? What did you just say?

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: Peng peng! I love giving smooches!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: Give me a smooch too, master!

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: I thought I heard something weird...

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: It's like the violent winds of El nath...

string.name: c14_s1
string.value: Peeng! Excuse me for a second then!

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: Peeng peeng... I didn't even eat that much...

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: Peeng... I don't feel like pooping.

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: Peeng! Can you block for me?

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: Take me to a restroom! Peeng?

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: Peeng peeng... do I really have to?

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: I think I need a laxative... Peeng...

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: Don't forget to clean up after I'm done! Peeng!

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: That's so embarrassing! I can't... I can't! Peng!

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: I think that's against the law...

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: I'm too cute to poop! No way! Peng peng!

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: Peng? Really? You really think so?

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: Thank you for the compliment! Peng peng!

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: You're trying to butter me up!

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: I like it better when you're honest...

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: I've heard that a million times!

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: I have an awesome owner! Peng peng!

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: Peng peng! I know, everybody tells me that.

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: You know how to make a penguin happy! Peng!

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: Can't you say something more original? Peeng?

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: You sure know how to look at a penguin! Peng peng!

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: I feel like I'm falling for you all over again! Peng peng!

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: Peng peng! I'm not as awesome as you, though!

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: I feel like I can fly when you say that! Peng peng!

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: I want to hear 'cool' more than 'pretty'! Peng!

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: Sounds like you're just trying to flatter me. Peng?

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: Peng? I didn't hear you. Can you say that again?

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: Are you sure I don't look fat?

string.name: c22_s1
string.value: Peng... I can feel your love!

string.name: c22_f1
string.value: Don't say tricky things to me! Peng peng...

string.name: c22_f2
string.value: I'm sorry, but you aren't my type. Peng peng.

string.name: c22_f4
string.value: Peng... love? Human language is difficult!

string.name: c23_s2
string.value: My love for you grows and grows!

string.name: c23_s3
string.value: What do I do? My heart won't stop beating! Peeng!

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: Peng peng! I just want to brag about this to everyone!

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: Why are you trying to flatter me like that?

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: Peng peng? Are you trying to eat me?

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: Peeng... I only like other penguins. Maybe a parrot...

string.name: c24_s1
string.value: Do you see my love overflowing?

string.name: c24_s2
string.value: Peeng! I feel like singing a song!

string.name: c24_s4
string.value: Love sure is a wonderful word. Peeng!

string.name: c24_f1
string.value: Penguins and humans can never be!

string.name: c24_f2
string.value: You should bring me a nice fish if you mean it.

string.name: c24_f4
string.value: I thought you were seeing someone already!

string.name: c25_s2
string.value: Peng peng! Human language is hard!

string.name: c25_s3
string.value: You may not think we get cold, but El Nath is super frosty!

string.name: c25_s4
string.value: I'm feeling a little chubby. Need more fish!

string.name: c25_f1
string.value: So what do you want me to say? Peeng?

string.name: c25_f2
string.value: When was the last time you saw a talking penguin?

string.name: c26_s1
string.value: Are you wondering if real penguins make the peng noise?

string.name: c26_s2
string.value: I want some mackerel ice cream. Peng!

string.name: c26_s3
string.value: The Pepes in El Nath are my mean cousins!

string.name: c26_s4
string.value: I can't fly, but I'm still a bird!

string.name: c26_f2
string.value: I want to hear you talk first. Peng...

string.name: c26_f3
string.value: ... I really don't have much to say. Peng?

string.name: c26_f4
string.value: Peeng... is there something you want to hear?

string.name: c27_s1
string.value: Pepes and yetis are friends, but penguins hate yetis! Peeng.

string.name: c27_s2
string.value: Chloe is really good at knitting! You didn't know that, did you?

string.name: c27_s3
string.value: Someone even asked me whether I really have legs. Peeng...

string.name: c27_s4
string.value: Peng peng... Sometimes I want to fly in the sky.

string.name: c27_f1
string.value: Talking to your pets makes you look like a crazy person!

string.name: c27_f2
string.value: I don't really have anything to talk about...

string.name: c27_f4
string.value: There are too many people here.

string.name: c28_s3
string.value: Peng peng! I totally feel the love!

string.name: c28_s4
string.value: Hugs make me warm! Peng peng!

string.name: c28_f3
string.value: I thought you wanted my hand?

string.name: c29_s2
string.value: Hug me tight, master! Peng peng!

string.name: c29_s3
string.value: I love being hugged by you, master!

string.name: c29_s4
string.value: I can't reach you, master! Pick me up! Peng peng!

string.name: c29_f2
string.value: Eh, give me a flipper instead!

string.name: c29_f3
string.value: There are too many people watching!

string.name: c29_f4
string.value: I'll pretend I didn't hear that!

string.name: c30_s1
string.value: I love my hug-loving master! Peng!

string.name: c30_s3
string.value: Hug me! Hug me! Hug me master!

string.name: c30_f2
string.value: Should I shake your hand instead? Peng.

string.name: c30_f3
string.value: We need to talk about personal boundaries...

string.name: c30_f4
string.value: I don't want to do that in public!

string.name: c31_f1
string.value: Sleep on the ground? Where's the ice?

string.name: c31_f2
string.value: I can't sleep when I'm not sleepy. Peng!

string.name: c31_f3
string.value: Penguins sleep on full bellies. Peng peng!

string.name: c32_s3
string.value: I hope I see a Pepe in my dreams... Peeng...

string.name: c32_f1
string.value: There's not even a bed! Why do you hate me?

string.name: c32_f2
string.value: You're going to run away as soon as I close my eyes!

string.name: c32_f3
string.value: What, do you think I'm lazy?

string.name: c33_s1
string.value: You sleep well too. Peng peng!

string.name: c33_s2
string.value: I want to sleep on your lap... Peeng...

string.name: c33_s3
string.value: I love napping when you're around... Peeng...

string.name: c33_f1
string.value: If I sleep too much, I'll get fatter... then I won't be as cute!

string.name: c34_s2
string.value: I'll be able to fly one day, right?

string.name: c34_s3
string.value: One day, penguins will fly like eagles!

string.name: c34_f1
string.value: You have to teach me how to fly first... Peeng...

string.name: c34_f2
string.value: What will you give me if I fly? Peng?

string.name: c34_f3
string.value: Peeng? Have you ever seen a penguin fly?

string.name: c35_s1
string.value: I'll show you that penguins can fly too! Peeng!

string.name: c35_s2
string.value: I flew! I flew! Sort of...

string.name: c35_s3
string.value: I'll fly us away to the moon one day!

string.name: c35_f1
string.value: Oh, no, my belly's too heavy.

string.name: c35_f2
string.value: You really think it's possible to fly with these wings? Peng?

string.name: c35_f3
string.value: Peng peng? I can't fly away and leave you here all alone!

string.name: f2_s
string.value: Thank you for the food! Peng peng!

string.name: f2_f
string.value: Arg... I'm too full. It's impossible to eat anymore... Peng...

string.name: f3_s
string.value: Peeng! Maybe I'll get taller if I keep eating!!

string.name: f3_f
string.value: My stomach is going to pop... peng...

string.name: f4_s
string.value: Wow! It must be delicious! Thank you! Peng!

string.name: f4_f
string.value: Peeng... Do you have a grudge against me?

string.name: s3
string.value: Aren't you supposed to talk nicely? Peeng?

string.name: s4
string.value: Peeng? I'll get upset if you keep saying weird things!

string.name: c2_s1
string.value: Aye, I could use a little break.

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: Ahh, nothin' like relaxin' on a bomb.

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: Go on, cap'n. I'll watch this bomb.

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: Why do ye ask such things?

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: I agree, it be time for a rest.

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: This bomb be special, ye know.

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: Ye should rest as well. I worry about ye.

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: Yarr, me legs were gettin' tired.

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: Don't make me peck at ye.

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: That not be a very inspirin' order.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: Now all I be needin' is some blueberries.

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: I not be sleepin'. Just restin' me eyes.

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: I not be carin' for ye orders.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: Ye not be understandin' who yer messin' with...

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: Do I look like a dog to ye?

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: Don't make me walk the plank!

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: Ye need to be more carin' than that.

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: Bah. I be wantin' some grub.

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: I be reflectin' upon me mistakes.

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: Sorry. I'll be a much better pirate.

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: Keep this up, and ye'll have a mutiny on ye hands!

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: You treat ye crew like this?

string.name: c10_s1
string.value: Ye be my best mate, capn'n.

string.name: c10_s2
string.value: If we be stuck together, I be okay with that.

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: Always good to have the cap'n's ear!

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: That's behavior unbecoming a pirate, cap'n!

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: Life at sea be lonely, cap'n. Deal with it.

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: I feel a bit sick, cap'n. And I not be seasick.

string.name: c10_f4
string.value: Stop givin' me the crazy eye, cap'n!

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: Ahoy there! Ye be makin' me feathers all ruffled.

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: That's a good one, cap'n. Never gets old.

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: That's good, cap'n. We are shipmates, after all.

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: I'm so glad our piratey ways brought us t'gether!

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: Yarr, I be tryin' ta eat here!

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: Not sure how I feel about bein' yer crew, cap'n.

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: Yeah you do. No surprise there.

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: You gone soft on me, cap'n?

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: Ye be the only cap'n for me!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: I be swashin' any buckles you want!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: I'll be ye first mate anytime, cap'n.

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: This be the happiest moment in me piratey life.

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: Nay, cap'n, my ladybird awaits me at our next port of call.

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: That's inappropriate conduct for a cap'n, cap'n.

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: I love TREASURE, cap'n. And you should, too.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: Ye compliment is bilgewater to me.

string.name: c13_s3
string.value: Now THAT is a real pirate's poop.

string.name: c13_f3
string.value: Even pirates have standards, ye scallywag!

string.name: c13_f4
string.value: This not be the poop deck, cap'n.

string.name: c14_s1
string.value: Yarr, I be a few pounds lighter now!

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: Yarr, I be givin' it all I've got!

string.name: c14_s4
string.value: I'm not swabbin' up after this, cap'n.

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: Ye be one strange pirate, cap'n...

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: This be hurtin' me confidence in ye.

string.name: c15_s2
string.value: It be an unhealthy obsession, but I be needin' ta go...

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: I'll not cross swords 'till I've had a good poop!

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: I've made me own buried treasure!

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: Ye be havin' the sea crazies, cap'n?

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: I be dreamin' of plunder tonight.

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: I be sleepin' well with a bomb under me pillow.

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: Ye takin' first watch, cap'n? Goodnight, then.

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: Nay, cap'n, there's work to be done!

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: The sun be shinin'! I can't sleep now!

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: There's plenty more fight in me, cap'n!

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: You sleep. I be takin' first watch.

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: Aye, just need a good bomb to sleep on.

string.name: c17_s2
string.value: Ye shouldn't disturb a sleepin' pirate...

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: You keep watch, cap'n...I'll get some shut-eye.

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: I've plenty of fire in me! I don't need sleep!

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: I'm not following that order! I'll mutiny!

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: Nay, cap'n, there's piratin' to be done!

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: Aye, I could use a little sleep after that.

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: Gonna catch a few winks before our next voyage.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: Time for bed. Hope the bomb don't blow.

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: Aye, I'll be dreamin' of booty!

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: Ye don't have ta give orders all the time, cap'n!

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: Why sleep when there's pillaging to be done?

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: Don't make me turn on ye!

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: Ye should repect me! I be a scary pirate!

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: I'm gonna be king of the pirates!

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: One day, I'll own me own ship...the Black Pebble.

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: Want to see me treasure map? Ha! Too bad!

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: I once lived with a navy admiral, ye know.

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: Let's hear ye story first, cap'n.

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: I don't trust ye enough to share me secrets...

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: I broke free from a navy admiral's cage.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: The sea be the only place for me.

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: I be in love with blueberries, ye know.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Have ye planned dinner? I be wantin' fruits!

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: If ye be bored, round us up some treasure!

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: I'll be a great captain meself one day.

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: This hat be the finest silk, ye know.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: We spend too much time on land, cap'n!

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: I always wanted to be a pirate.

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: Nay, it be me alone time.

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: I'll abandon ship if ye keep this up!

string.name: c22_s2
string.value: See these? These be skin-color tights!

string.name: c22_s3
string.value: For me next trick, I'll break out of me cage!

string.name: c22_s4
string.value: This be only for ye, cap'n!

string.name: c22_f4
string.value: I be too hungry for ye tricks.

string.name: c23_s1
string.value: I'd like to see ye do this!

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: I be gettin' sick of ye pesterin'.

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: Oh, no. Ye go first, cap'n.

string.name: f3_f
string.value: Me belly be full ta burstin'!

string.name: f4_s
string.value: It be too delicious, I say!

string.name: s3
string.value: Ye be abusin' the chain of command.

string.name: s4
string.value: Do ye need to go back ta cap'n school?

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: I sit on ground for now.

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: You no want I steal gold? I steal good, Mr'kuma.

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: Don't wanna! I wanna set your hair on fire!

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Sit? Me not know word. Hehehe...

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: Okay, human. You tell me when we are going to eat monsters again.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I will sit for you, Mr'kuma. You are scary and powerful!

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: I do as you say, for now...

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: Later, you sit and I get to burn houses down!

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: No way! I am not your kr'grana!

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: I don't wanna! I am mighty and full of fangs!

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: Rak! Why you always want to sit?!

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: You take me to lake of fire first!

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: My old boss was scary too. He eat my brother! So fun!

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: You scare many monsters with your talk! Scare me a little too...

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: No talk to me like kr'gana. Me much strong!

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: Rak unar! I eat your wallet tonight!

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: I like it when you are angry, Mr'kuma. I will be angry too!

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Yes! Let's find some little kids to yell at!

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: Everytime you yell, I feel a little more at home...

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: Ha! More! Tell me how worthless I am!

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: You always say the same insults. Think up something new!

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: I know you can do better than that, Mr'kuma.

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: I know you have more rage in you than that...

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: I don't want to be flattered right now!

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: Why you talk like wimp, Mr'kuma?

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: Grauk-mouthed unar! You think I simple?!

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: I no fall for trick. Old Mr'kuma trick me like this long ago.

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: Hand over wallet, Mr'kuma. You go crazy in your mind.

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: I come back when you not trying to eat me.

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: You are the cruelest of all masters...and I like it.

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: Are you mad at me because I tortured your goldfish? He was asking for it!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: That is the rudest thing you can say in demon culture!

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: Now I see you are just trying to be mean to me. Thank you, Mr'kuma!

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: There is no such thing as love.

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: My heart is cold and black like a piece of coal!

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: I'm almost getting used to this constant abuse.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: You're just trying to make me get mad again.

string.name: c14_s1
string.value: Why say word "poop" all time, Mr'aku?

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: You like drakla so much? I give to you.

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: I not eat enough monster today!

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: You no treasure drakla. It MY drakla!

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: Master, you love pooping as much as I do!

string.name: c15_s2
string.value: I bet I can burn a hole in the ground with this one...

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: I love stinking up your fresh air, Mr'kuma.

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: Empty out everything, master. Even your soul!

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: I'll let go of this poop when I darn well feel like it.

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: My bottom still hurts from the last one.

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: I have got to stop eating so many spicy monsters.

string.name: c17_s2
string.value: Good unar. We find many nightmare!

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: I like sleep. Let me eat many monster heads when wake.

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: You sleep too, Mr'kuma. I steal many wallet for you later.

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: No! You try take my eyeballs while I sleep!

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: I no want to! I want eat shopkeeper toes!

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: Sleep yourself, Mr'putama. I go find demon friends.

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: I could go for a little power nap on some hot coals.

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: Don't destroy any villages without me, okay, Mr'kuma?

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: I'll wake up when home freezes over.

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: Pitchforks, fire, and screaming people. This is going to be a great dream.

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: You can go to sleep if you want. I promise not to chew on your nose.

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: I don't need to rest! I'm an infernal machine!

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: I ate an entire case of espresso beans while you weren't looking.

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: I know better than to trust you.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: I am Mr'kuma to ghost of fear like you are Mr'kuma to me.

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: Have you ever felt true fear, unar-master?

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I will let you avoid fear, if you prove that you are strong.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: I will show you the face of fear! Mwahaha!

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: If you can scare me like my old boss, we can hang out.

string.name: c22_s1
string.value: I make poona energy for you, Mr'kuma!

string.name: c22_s2
string.value: See my power! We destroy much together!

string.name: c22_s4
string.value: My real form is scary, Mr'kuma!

string.name: c22_f2
string.value: You do trick. I want laugh when you fall.

string.name: c22_f4
string.value: I show you already! You have bad brain!

string.name: c23_s1
string.value: What if I did this at your next surprise party?

string.name: c23_s2
string.value: Let's go scare some little girls with this trick!

string.name: c23_s3
string.value: With this power, I could conquer all of you puny humans.

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: Bask in awe, master! I am a being of pure terror!

string.name: c23_f1
string.value: How about I torch all your underwear instead?

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: Are you sure? You can never unsee it.

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: Shouldn't we be undermining somebody's hope?

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: I'll eat your eyebrows if you tell me that again!

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: Sleep yourself, Mr'putama. I go find demon friends.

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: I could go for a little power nap on some hot coals.

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: Don't destroy any villages without me, okay, Mr'kuma?

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: I'll wake up when home freezes over.

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: Pitchforks, fire, and screaming people. This is going to be a great dream.

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: You can go to sleep if you want. I promise not to chew on your nose.

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: I don't need to rest! I'm an infernal machine!

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: I ate an entire case of espresso beans while you weren't looking.

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: I know better than to trust you.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: I am Mr'kuma to ghost of jealousy like you are Mr'kuma to me.

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: Have you felt jealousy of another, unar-master?

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I will let you avoid jealousy, if you prove that you are strong.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: You will see the firey hand of jealousy!

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: If you can make me jealous, we can have a real relationship.

string.name: c22_s1
string.value: I make poona energy for you, Mr'kuma!

string.name: c22_s2
string.value: See my power! We destroy much together!

string.name: c22_s4
string.value: My real form is scary, Mr'kuma!

string.name: c22_f2
string.value: You do trick. I want laugh when you fall.

string.name: c22_f4
string.value: I show you already! You have bad brain!

string.name: c23_s1
string.value: What if I did this at your next surprise party?

string.name: c23_s2
string.value: Let's go scare some little girls with this trick!

string.name: c23_s3
string.value: With this power, I could conquer all of you puny humans.

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: Bask in awe, master! I am a being of pure terror!

string.name: c23_f1
string.value: How about I torch all your underwear instead?

string.name: c23_f2
string.value: Are you sure? You can never unsee it.

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: Shouldn't we be undermining somebody's hope?

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: I'll eat your eyebrows if you tell me that again!

string.name: f4_f
string.value: What are you trying to do to me?!

string.name: s3
string.value: Old boss call me that. He so cool.

string.name: s4
string.value: Hey! Even we demons have some etiquette.

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: I think I will, thank you.

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: I'm extra adorable when I sit. Look!

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: As you wish! Can I have some ramen now?

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: Sigh, why are you so bossy?

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: I think better on my feet.

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: All right. I think I deserve a rest.

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: A bowl of ramen would make this moment perfect.

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: Sure. Why don't you sit with me?

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: What? Here? At least get me a chair.

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: I don't want to get my tail dirty.

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: I'll sit here and think about ramen.

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: My legs are short and cute, but they get tired sometime.

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: I want to travel, not sit!

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: I really don't feel like sitting right now.

string.name: c6_s1
string.value: You're right. Just 'cause I'm cute doesn't mean I can get away with everything.

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: If I let you have my ramen, will you stop scolding me? Please?

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: You don't know what you're talking about.

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: Are you TRYING to make me mad?

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: If I behave, will you give me some ramen?

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: You're going to make me cry!

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: You still love me, don't you?

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: C'mon. You can't scold someone THIS cute.

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: I'll run away, and then you'll regret getting mad at me.

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: Don't stand so close to me.

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: For that, I'll let you scratch my tummy.

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: Do I look easy to you?

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: Then shower me with ramen, please!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: I always knew I was irresistible.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: Not as much as I love myself.

string.name: c13_s1
string.value: When you gotta go, you gotta go.

string.name: c14_s2
string.value: Hope you brought along toilet paper!

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: Such a perfectly round little pelle!

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: Not right now. I have a headache.

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: You into that sort of thing?

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: Does this make me a party POOPer? Get it?

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: Hey! Are you saying I have a stick up my butt?

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: Will you sing me a lullaby?

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: Don't even THINK of using me as a pillow.

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: You're not the boss of me.

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: You can sleep if you want. I'm busy.

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: I hope I dream of ramen.

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: I count pies and donuts to fall asleep.

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: Will you pet me until I doze off?

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: I only sleep on silk sheets.

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: Last time I slept, someone tied my tail to my ears. Pass!

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: I'm refusing just to be rebellious.

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: I suppose I could afford to take a break.

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: Hey, I just wanted to tell you that I think you're really... Zzz.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: You should rest, too. You can cuddle with me.

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: Coffee ramen, pizza ramen, donut ramen... Zzz.

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: Do I LOOK sleepy to you?

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: You're so lazy, sometimes you disgust me.

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: I have recipes to create! No time for sleep!

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: I'm not chubby, I'm big-boned. Just wanted to let you know.

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: Everybody who meets me, loves me. Didja know that?

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: Just 'cause I'm cute doesn't mean my life is easy.

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: Ramen is really good with sugar and honey. Try it!

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: Go away. I'm sick of your face.

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: Why do you always follow me around?

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: Ugh, what do you want from me?

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: My dream is to become the world's best ramen chef!

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: I think about new ramen recipes all the time. Imagine: deep-fried ramen!

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: Here's a secret: my parents can transform into human shape.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Do you think red herb ramen would do well in this market?

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: Don't you have anyone else to pester?

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: You must be really lonely to be bothering me.

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I'm going to pretend I don't see you.

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: Don't speak until you're spoken to!

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: I figure, if I stick with you, I'll get to travel and try all sorts of ramen!

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I'm actually a really great dancer. I've got the perfect figure for it.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: People who want to bring me down say I'm fat, but I know it isn't true.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: Sometimes people tell me I have no parents. I don't get it. I DO have parents!

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: Do I LOOK like I'm in the mood?

string.name: c22_s1
string.value: We can dance if we want to!

string.name: c22_s2
string.value: Ah, I'm so adorable when I dance, I want to hug myself.

string.name: c22_s3
string.value: You love me even more than before I danced, don't you?

string.name: c22_f1
string.value: I'm not here for your amusement.

string.name: c22_f2
string.value: I'll think about it, IF you get me some ramen.

string.name: c22_f3
string.value: Believe it or not, I'm actually quite shy.

string.name: c23_s2
string.value: You ain't never seen nobody as cute as me!

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: Buy me a mirror so I can admire myself when I dance!

string.name: c23_f1
string.value: What, and then you'll give me a treat? How demeaning.

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: I'm on strike until you take me to a new ramen restaurant.

string.name: f3_s
string.value: This is why I love you.

string.name: f3_f
string.value: I could eat ten servings in one sitting!

string.name: f4_f
string.value: Mouth...likes. Stomach, not so much. Too full!

string.name: s4
string.value: I can hear you, you know.

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: Landed too hard. Bruised my butt.

string.name: c2_f1
string.value: No thanks. Sometimes when I try to sit, I trip.

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: Well, I guess I could use a rest.

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: Would you look at that view! Beautiful world we live in, general.

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: Sit with me? We can discuss our adventuring strategies, general.

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: Whew, I guess I am a little tired.

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: But we still have a lot further to go!

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: To be honest, it's not that easy for me to sit down.

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: I'll just snuggle here next to you, general.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: Oh, good. I needed to groom my wings anyway.

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: My wings need exercise. They're getting pudgy!

string.name: c6_s1
string.value: Please don't hit me! Are you going to hit me?

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: No! I'll be good! I promise!

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: When I hum to myself, I can't hear you.

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: I'm going to crawl under a rock.

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: I think I'm going to cry!

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: I'm sorry! I'm sorry! Don't hurt me!

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: You just might make me angry for the first time in my life.

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: Be nice to me! Please! I'm sorry!

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: You... You still love me, don't you?

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: But I love CARROTS, not you.

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: I'm so happy I could fly, except I'm scared of heights.

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: Do you have to say that in such a creepy voice?

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: Just keep galloping. Just keep galloping.

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: You're the strongest, bestest person I know.

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: Just feed me and don't talk, please.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: I'd like to be alone right now.

string.name: c13_s2
string.value: Got any toilet paper? I'm all out.

string.name: c13_s4
string.value: Oh! I feel much better now! Neigh!

string.name: c14_s2
string.value: I'll try not to lose my balance and fall in this time.

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: Hey, it's orange! Just like my favorite food, carrots!

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: An adventurer never poops in public!

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: Whoops, is that a brown speck on my wing?

string.name: c15_s2
string.value: Does the texture look a little off to you?

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: Quick! Make sure no one's peeking!

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: I don't need to go right now.

string.name: c16_s1
string.value: This is how I snore: zzzeigh, zzzeigh.

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: I could use a quick little nappy nap.

string.value: A true adventurer never rests! Right?

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: When I close my eyes, it gets dark, and I'm scared of the dark.

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: But what if monsters get me?!

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: I think you just want an excuse to nap.

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: I hope I dream of carrots!

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: Don't let anyone hurt me, mmkay?

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: But what if I get nightmares?

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: You sleep, general. I'll stand guard.

string.value: Can you buy me a stuffed carrot to hug?

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: Keep me secret, keep me safe, general.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: Wake me up if anything interesting happens.

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: I can't keep my eyes open. Zzzzzeigh.

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: But I just downed an energy drink!

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: No! I want to have an adventure!

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: Carrots are amazing! They're nutritious, orange, pointy...

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: I lick my wings to keep them clean, just like a kitten.

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: If you have a heart of courage, the world is your carrot!

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: I want to be alone right now, please.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: Sometimes people call me a unicorn, so I tried tying a carrot on my head.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: My second favorite thing in the world? Carrots. My first favorite thing? YOU!

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: I want to be just like you when I grow up!

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Where should we adventure to next, general? I can't wait!

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: We're too busy to talk right now!

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: I trip over my own feet sometimes, but I won't let that stop me!

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: Sometimes, my wings get tangled up in each other and I fall on my face.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: Do you think I'm brave, general? I really hope you do.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: What's your favorite? Deep-fried carrot, carrot steak, or carrot stew?

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: We should save our energy for our adventures!

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: I'm not good at small talk.

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: But I want to hear about YOUR adventurers, general!

string.name: c22_s2
string.value: Heh, not everyone can pull THIS off.

string.name: c22_s3
string.value: Hold on to your hats, ladies and gents!

string.name: c22_f1
string.value: I'm an adventurer, not a circus performer!

string.name: c23_s1
string.value: Think I deserve a carrot for this, general?

string.name: c23_s3
string.value: Let's see a unicorn try to pull this off.

string.name: c23_s4
string.value: This comes in real handy for an explorer like me.

string.name: c23_f4
string.value: Don't tell me what to do, please.

string.name: f3_f
string.value: Hey, I'm a colt, not a pig!

string.name: s2
string.value: General! An adventurer ought to know better!

string.name: s4
string.value: Do you see the disappointment in my eyes, general?

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: Funny, I was just planning to sit anyway.

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: I actually look better when I'm sitting.

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: I shall sit, but NOT because you told me to.

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: And why should I listen to you?

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: I can't hear you . Speak up.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I never tire, I'm just sitting for fun.

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: I will permit you to sit next to me.

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: I can neither hear nor see you right now.

string.name: c6_s1
string.value: Hmph. Fine. I get the point.

string.name: c6_s2
string.value: You'll never hear me say this again, but I'm sorry.

string.name: c6_s3
string.value: I suppose you detest me now.

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: I KNOW you're not talking to ME.

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: I'll do you a favor and pretend I didn't hear that.

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: You have three seconds to take that back.

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: Fine! Just don't expect an apology.

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: I don't even know what I did.

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: But I'm always up to no good!

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: I don't even know why I'm saying this, but sorry.

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: Why are you acting like this?

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: How DARE you speak to me like this!

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: I suppose I ought to say thanks, but instead I'll say: SCRAM.

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: You have to do better than that.

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: So many fans, so little time to crush all their hearts.

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: Yes, I'm one of a kind.

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: Stick around. I might have some use for you.

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: You're kidding yourself if you think you have a chance with me.

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: Have you looked in a mirror lately?

string.name: c14_s1
string.value: Now clean it up. Use your hands.

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: Consider that a favor. Now you owe me.

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: Some things you just don't do in public.

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: You're not even going to bribe me?

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: I don't know if you can tell, but I'm rolling my eyes.

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: Don't bother me while I sleep.

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: Okay, but only because I want to.

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: You think you can just tell me what to do?

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: Maybe if you weren't so NOISY.

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: I better get something out of this.

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: Do you have any idea what time it is?

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: But I'll have nightmares about your face.

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: Your stench is too strong. Can't fall asleep.

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: You really think you can make me?

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: I can spend hours thinking of ways to make people cry.

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: There's nothing more satisfying than an evil deed done well.

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: The weather annoys me. Change it.

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: You want me to talk? There, I talked.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: I enjoy traveling. Why else do you think I let you hang around?

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: I enjoy food. So feed me.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Sometimes, I wonder where I came from.

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: Just who do you think you're bossing around?

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: If I wanted to talk, I'd talk.

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: I want to lock all the people I despise into a dark, windowless room.

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: Big Headward has an awfully large head for such a small brain.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: Some creatires are so ugly, I don't know how they can stand to look in the mirror

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: That Wonky the Fairy'll eat anything. I've tested it.

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: I'm the silent but deadly type.

string.name: f2_s
string.value: Well, well. Not bad at all.

string.name: f4_f
string.value: Are you blind? Can't you see that I'm full?

string.name: s3
string.value: Try to keep it classy, will you?

string.name: s4
string.value: Mind your manners. You embarrass me.

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: Pyoo, let's a rest a little!

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: Pyoo! I'm going to play more!

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: Pyoo? Don't we still have a long way to go?

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Ookyu? I don't want to rest right now...

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: Pyoo! Am I sitting down, or laying down?

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: Ookyu, it's the perfect time to rest!

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: Pyoo! Just for a minute, okay?

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: Ookyu? I don't like being ordered around!

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: We can't rest like this everyday!

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: Ookyu, just a couple more steps!

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: Pyoo? Are you hurt? Why do you keep wanting to rest?

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: Don't talk to me like that!

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: Pyoo! Are you really going to keep doing this?!

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: I said, don't order me around!

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: Ookyu... I miss the north pole...

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: Pyoo! I'm going to leave you then!

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Sorry... I won't do it again...

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: Hmph! I told you to treat me nicely!!

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: Pyoo!! I'm going back to the north pole!

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: I'm going to tell on you!

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: Pyoo! I can be scary too!

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: I like you very much also!

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: Pyoo! I like you better than the north pole.

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: Pyoo! I'm so lucky to have a master like you!

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: Pyoo! I love hanging out with you.

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: Pyoo! I'll be with you forever!

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: Ookyu, did you eat some bad fish?

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: I'm a Harp Seal, and you are a human!

string.name: c13_f3
string.value: Ookyu! You should be ashamed of yourself!

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: Tell me that AFTER you feed me!!

string.name: c14_f2
string.value: You can't order me to do everything!

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: Ookyu! Every day is a healthy day!!

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: This is shameful! You'll be hearing from my Harp Lawyers!

string.value: I've got nothing to say right now.

string.value: Hey! Even we devils have some etiquette.

string.value: I sit on ground for now.

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: I sit on ground for now.

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: You no want I steal gold? I steal good, Mr'kuma.

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: Don't wanna! I wanna set your hair on fire!

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Sit? Me not know word. Hehehe...

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: Okay, human. You tell me when we are going to eat monsters again.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I will sit for you, Mr'kuma. You are scary and powerful!

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: I do as you say, for now...

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: Later, you sit and I get to burn houses down!

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: No way! I am not your kr'grana!

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: I don't wanna! I am mighty and full of fangs!

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: Rak! Why you always want to sit?!

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: You take me to lake of fire first!

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: No talk to me like kr'gana. Me much strong!

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: Rak unar! I eat your wallet tonight!

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: My old boss was scary too. He eat my brother! So fun!

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: You scare many monsters with your talk! Scare me a little too...

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: No talk to me like kr'gana. Me much strong!

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: Rak unar! I eat your wallet tonight!

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: I like it when you are angry, Mr'kuma. I will be angry too!

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Yes! Let's find some little kids to yell at!

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: Everytime you yell, I feel a little more at home...

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: Ha! More! Tell me how worthless I am!

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: You always say the same insults. Think up something new!

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: I know you can do better than that, Mr'kuma.

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: I know you have more rage in you than that...

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: I don't want to be flattered right now!

string.value: Why you talk like wimp, Mr'kuma?

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: Grauk-mouthed unar! You think I simple?!

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: Grauk-mouthed unar! You think I simple?!

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: I no fall for trick. Old Mr'kuma trick me like this long ago.

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: You are the cruelest of all masters...and I like it.

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: Are you mad at me because I tortured your goldfish? He was asking for it!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: That is the rudest thing you can say in devil culture!

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: Now I see you are just trying to be mean to me. Thank you, Mr'kuma!

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: There is no such thing as love.

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: My heart is cold and black like a piece of coal!

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: I'm almost getting used to this constant abuse.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: You're just trying to make me get mad again.

string.value: Master, you love pooping as much as I do!

string.value: My bottom still hurts from the last one.

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: I have got to stop eating so many spicy monsters.

string.value: I'd like to think I'm tough. Ook.

string.value: I'm tired of people telling me that. Ook.

string.name: c16_s1
string.value: Just so you know, I do this when I'm angry. I'm serious. Hee hee.

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: Really? You really think so? Heh heh heh! Ahem, well, I've heard that many times. Ook?

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: Ook? I'm really not happy, but I can't stop my tail...

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: I-I didn't hear what you just said. Ooook! I didn't!

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: Please, I'm done with compliments. Ook.

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: S-sure, you're cute too. That's what you wanted to hear, right?

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: Oook? I'm hungry. I need food, not empty compliments.

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: I'm grateful that you care for me, but sometimes you're too clingy. Oook.

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: Ugh! What was that? My heart just skipped a beat. Ook.

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: Ook? Something's wrong with my heart. What is it?

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: Oook... I think I'm in love...

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: Thanks... Though I'm having a hard time believing what's happening. Ook.

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: So, what do you want from me? Ook, oook!

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: Oook... I knew how you felt about me, but hearing it makes me happy just the same.

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: I-is this what you call love? Ook?

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: Ooook... Did you just confess your love to me? I think I'm happy...

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: I like you so much, I can't contain myself. Oook!

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: Enough with your love. I need food. Ook.

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: Ook? Aren't you tired of saying that?

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: If you're lonely, find someone else. I'm tired of you hitting on me. Ook.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: D-don't think what you just said made me happy. If you're seeing hearts, you're hallucinating! Ook!

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: You dummy! You shouldn't say that so loud...others can hear you! Ooook!

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: Y-you're making me blush... Of course I'm happy. Ook.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Oook... I can't move... Maybe I'm too happy.

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: You've been saying that so much, now I don't know if I should trust you.

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: Stop talking nonsense and go away. Ook.

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: Ook... I understand you're lonely, but c'mon.

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: Please don't compare me to other monkeys. Ook.

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: The Happy Valley is a nice neighborhood, though not as nice as my hometown. Ook.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: Oook, 500 years ago, I was strong enough to bring down a Yeti with one blow.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: Ook! Don't ask me how pet feed tastes. Taste it yourself.

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: I don't have anything to say. Ook.

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: I'm not in the mood to talk. Ooook... You talk.

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: Ook... I'm so hungry, I can't talk. Feed me.

string.name: c22_s1
string.value: I hate being turned into a doll. Ook. I would rather get locked up in jail.

string.name: c22_s2

string.name: c22_s3
string.value: I hate being hungry. I hate being punished. But I hate being alone more than anything. Ook.

string.name: c22_s4
string.value: Oook... I can't talk to other pets. They just don't speak the same language.

string.name: c22_f1
string.value: You talk first, then I might. Ook.

string.value: I thought you didn't want me to talk because I'm too loud. Ook?

string.name: c22_f4
string.value: Are you that bored? I'm a pet, not a human. Ook?

string.value: Ook. How do I shapeshift? Well, I could tell you, but you wouldn't understand.

string.value: We should keep quiet in public. Ook. We're not barbarians.

string.value: We penguins don't take that phrase "I love you" lightly.

string.name: c28_f3
string.value: If you don't mean that, that I don't think you should say it.

string.name: c29_s3
string.value: So I should just stick it out like this? WEK..

string.name: c30_s2
string.value: You know I'm the bomb, WEK.

string.name: c30_f1
string.value: No way, I'm too tired. WEK.

string.name: c30_f2
string.value: I'm too lazy to do this. WEK.

string.name: c31_s2
string.value: Heavy, isn't it? I can't fly with these, though.

string.name: c31_s3
string.value: Is it fluffy? It feels good, right? This is fuuuun!

string.name: c31_f1
string.value: Ugh, this is quite a chore.

string.name: c31_f3
string.value: What am I, a dog? I'm a penguin, you know!

string.name: c32_s3
string.value: Make sure not to leave a hole on my cheek!

string.name: c32_f1
string.value: Um... do you know exactly where we are right now?

string.name: c32_f3
string.value: No way, I don't wanna do it.

string.name: c33_s3
string.value: Don't do it for too long, though. Yay!

string.name: c33_f1
string.value: Who in the right mind would wanna kiss you?

string.name: c33_f3
string.value: You ain't doing this for free.

string.name: c33_f4
string.value: Tell me that was a joke.

string.name: c34_s3
string.value: I deserve a trophy for this performance!

string.name: c34_s4
string.value: I believe I can fly!!! WEK WEK!

string.name: c34_f1
string.value: Um...don't I look a litttttle hefty for that?

string.name: c34_f2
string.value: Hey, have you ever seen a flying penguin?

string.name: c34_f3
string.value: You must have lost your mind.

string.name: c35_s2
string.value: Show me another penguin that can fly like me.

string.name: c35_s4
string.value: No need to waste time. Here we go!

string.name: c35_f3
string.value: I suggest you study a little on penguin's anatomy.

string.name: c35_f4
string.value: Um, have you heard of Law of Gravity? Hello!!

string.name: c36_s1
string.value: I'm at a loss for words...WEK!

string.name: c36_s2
string.value: It's hard to find a penguin as cute-looking as me! WEK!

string.name: c36_s3
string.value: Hey, I've been cute for quite some time, you know! WEK!

string.name: c36_s4
string.value: Really? You're not kidding, right? WEK!

string.name: c36_f2
string.value: I'm not CUTE. I'm DASHING. WEK!!!

string.name: c36_f3
string.value: I NEED SOME TRUTH AROUND HERE! WEK!

string.name: c36_f4
string.value: What do you want me to say in return, WEK?

string.name: c37_s2
string.value: You won't find a penguin quite like me. Enjoy it!

string.name: c37_s3
string.value: I can never get enough of your compliments!

string.name: c37_s4
string.value: Thanks for your kind words! I really appreciate that!

string.name: c37_f1
string.value: Since when did we compliment each other anyway...

string.name: c37_f4
string.value: Feed me instead of waxing stupid poetics like that.

string.name: f2_f
string.value: I can't eat no more. WEK.

string.name: f3_f
string.value: Ugh, I feel like throwing up. WEK.

string.name: f4_f
string.value: I need to be on a diet.

string.name: c2_s1
string.value: Will you sit with me? Please?

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: I love sitting next to you!

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: Ah, a rest. Carrying a piece of fruit on my head sure is tiring.

string.name: c2_f1
string.value: Does sitting make me look fat?

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: If I sit, my cream'll turn sour!

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: Sitting makes me too easy to bite!

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: My doughy tush makes sitting so comfy!

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: You look like you could use a rest, too.

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: But I can keep walking forever!

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: Sit, stand, sit stand. You're gonna turn my cream into cheese.

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: At least put down a blanket or something.

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: I've gotten too chubby. I need exercise!

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: Together, we can do anything. Even sit!

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I'm in a good mood, so okay.

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: Your wish is my puffy command! Heehee!

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: You can sit. I'm going without you.

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: You just want to step on me.

string.name: c5_f2
string.value: It's because you're a poor role model.

string.name: c6_s1
string.value: What did I do? I'm sorry!

string.name: c6_s2
string.value: You're going to make me cry big, creamy tears!

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: I don't like you right now!

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: You're projecting your insecurities on to me, aren't you?

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: I'm so sorry I disappointed you!

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: Don't say that unless you mean it!

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: You have to forgive me because I love you.

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: But the creampuff fairy told me to do it!

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: Too busy eating to listen, la la.

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: I hate being in trouble. Hmph.

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: I feel all warm, like back in the oven!

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: Do you love me or do you love to eat me?

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: It's hard to hear you without ears.

string.name: c10_f4
string.value: Oh, just kiss my puffy butt.

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: You're as sweet as my filling!

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: My creamy filling IS pretty great.

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: If you love me, then squeeze me!

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: I WON'T LET YOU EAT ME!

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: I know what you're planning to do to me when my guard is down...

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: I love you so much, I'd even let you take a nibble!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: You make me the happiest creampuff alive!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: I feel all warm and gooey inside. Oh, wait. Hehe.

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: This is a trick, isn't it?

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: We're not even the same food group!

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: I know you secretly want to om nom me.

string.name: c13_s2
string.value: I love to flush! Flush! Flushhhh!

string.name: c13_s4
string.value: Thanks for buying me this mini toilet. Love it!

string.name: c13_f2
string.value: That's a faux pas in creampuff society.

string.name: c14_s1
string.value: Little cream poops, la la la!

string.name: c14_s2
string.value: Ooh, I think I saw a piece of fruit in that one!

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: I hope you brought a napkin to wipe me with!

string.name: c14_s4
string.value: My poop smells like fruit. Mmmmm!

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: But I just went last week.

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: The chef who made me would be so ashamed!

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: Go on and squeeze it all out of me!

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: Why didn't you buy me a stall with this toilet?!

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: But then I won't have any filling left inside!

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: You should get some rest, too.

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: Don't forget me while I'm sleeping!

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: It's not time for nite nite yet!

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: I'm going to dream of swimming in a pool of coffee.

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: I smell to good to sleep.

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: I can set my own schedule, thanks very much.

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: Whew, I could use a rest.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: Can I sleep in the palm of your hand?

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: I was the smallest creampuff in my entire batch!

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: Sometimes, I wish I were made of a different fruit. Like, cherries!

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: I have nightmares where a giggling girl tears me apart, limb by limb. Then eats me.

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: As my BFF, it's your job to make sure I don't get eaten!

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: What do you want from me? My brain's made of cream!

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: Creampuffs are for eating, not talking. Wait...

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: I have a lot on my mind lately. Get it?

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: A creampuff without cream might as well be dead.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: Someday, I'm going to have three creampuff babies: plain, chocolate, and green tea!

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: At first, my baker made me without legs, but I begged and begged, and now look how cute I am!

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: What's the oddest creampuff flavor you can think of? Coconut? Pineapple? Anchovies?

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: What makes you think a creampuff can talk?

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I hate small talk! I like big talk! Hehehe!

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: I support creampuff rights. We all deserve the right to not be eaten.

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I don't mind if you eat other creampuffs, as long as you don't eat ME.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: Sometimes I wish I were banana flavored. Bananas have all the fun.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: I want to be the first creampuff to travel to the moon.

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: Gee, YOU try chatting on demand.

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: Shhh! I'm watching a creampuff soap opera!

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: Are you making fun of the way I talk?

string.value: Are you trying to poison me?!

string.value: Ooooh, this is yummier than I am!

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: Takes one to know one! Meow.

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: I'm not in the mood for jokes! Meow.

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: Your words are full of pain. Meow.

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: Will you take back what you said if I act nice? Meow.

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: Mew! Mew! I'll be sad if you hate me.

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: Meow! I will be your friend, no matter what.

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: You are the one who is that word you said. Meow.

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: Clearly I'm smart! You are wrong. Meow.

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: I don't like your arrogant attitude. Meow!

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: I'm busy, so I'll ignore you! Meow!

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: I clean up after myself. I'm so squeaky clean! Meow.

string.name: c14_s4
string.value: Please turn your head, and plug your nose. Meow.

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: Where I come from, one does not just go anywhere. Meow!

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: How many times a day do you want me to go? Meow.

string.name: c15_s2
string.value: Look at it! I sculpted it to look like you. Meow.

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: My poo is in abundance... Like your love. Meow.

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: My roots must feed first. Meow!

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: I do not understand your poop obsession. Meow.

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: You cannot force the mountain to move. Meow.

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: You told me only to do that on your neighbor's yard. Meow.

string.name: c16_s1
string.value: Please turn your head, and plug your nose. Meow.

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: It looks just like you. Meow.

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: Let's go give this to the neighbor's puppy. Meow.

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: I must be fed to create waste. Meow.

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: Do not project your own needs on me. Meow!

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: I am not sure why you believe I should do that. Meow.

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: Only if I can go on your head. Meow.

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: You are so awesome today master! I think you must love meow.

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: I hear a scary dragon lives nearby... Shall I pay it a visit?

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: Nothing beats good food and a cuddle. Meow.

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: Why is the sky so blue, then? Meow.

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: I don't feel like it. Meow.

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: I was not created to talk...

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: Niki in the Night Market is so creepy. Meow.

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: Meow, you talking with other pets makes me jealous!

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: Why do Crimson Balrogs appear on ships? Meow.

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: I will eat whatever you feed meow... because it's from you!

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: W-why do you keep talking to meow?

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: Nope! Just because you said it, I won't!

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: Henesys's elder always gets so angry! Mew!

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: Meow, I'm so co-o-old. Hold me tightly.

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: I am the only talking cat.

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: Are you bored? Go study. Meow.

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: I can't hear you! I hear nothing!

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: Are you poking fun at meow talking?!

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I will do what you hate.

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: Mew! I'm shooting lasers of love.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: Am I cute? Am I? Meow.

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: Tell rabbit next door to do cute things. Meow!

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: You can't make me do it. Meow.

string.name: c22_s1
string.value: How did you know I'm cute?

string.name: c22_f2
string.value: You can't make meow do it!

string.name: c23_s2
string.value: I will feel the power in my legs once more.

string.name: c23_f1
string.value: I can't stand on two feet!

string.name: c24_s3
string.value: I practiced every day for this moment!

string.name: c24_f1
string.value: I fell and can't get up!

string.name: c26_s1
string.value: I will admit to some feelings of adoration.

string.name: c26_f3
string.value: Things move slower where I'm come from.

string.name: c26_f4
string.value: You and meow are not meant to be!

string.name: c27_s3
string.value: Mew! My tail is happy too.

string.name: c28_s1
string.value: I was going to say so first.

string.name: c28_f3
string.value: I love the rabbit next door.

string.name: f3_s
string.value: Is this going to give me love handles?

string.name: f4_s
string.value: Prrr... Your specials are the best specials out there!

string.name: s2
string.value: Why must meow say such ridiculous things?

string.value: Don't we still have a long way to go?

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: I don't want to rest right now...

string.value: Am I sitting down, or laying down?

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: It's the perfect time to rest!

string.value: I don't like being ordered around!

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: We can't rest like this every day!

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: Are you hurt? Why do you keep wanting to rest?

string.value: Don't talk to me like that!

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: I said, don't order me around!

string.value: Sorry... I won't do it again...

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: Hmph! I told you to treat me nicely!

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: I'm going back to the north pole!

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: I'm going to tell on you!

string.value: I like you better than the north pole.

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: I'm so lucky to have a master like you!

string.value: I love hanging out with you.

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: Did you eat some bad fish?

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: I'm a Harp Seal, and you are a human!

string.value: Tell me that AFTER you feed me!

string.value: You can't order me to do everything!

string.value: Make sure no one's looking, okay?

string.value: This is shameful! You'll be hearing from my Harp Lawyers!

string.value: Look, the sun is still up!

string.value: Still a long way to go!

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: I'll sleep when I get sleepy, okies?

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: Why do you always tell me to sleep?

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: Is this going to make us closer?

string.value: I saw this weird animal in the forest...

string.value: What's the difference between real and fake seals?
