string.name: c12_f2
string.value: Pretty sure I heard you tell another pet that...

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: It's so hard to go with your flow sometimes.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: I'm not often speechless, but dang.

string.name: c13_s3
string.value: Do you really need to watch?

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: Fine, I'll take care of it.

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: I had a good one today.

string.name: c15_s2
string.value: It's important that you poop right every day.

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: Please do not speak of my poo.

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: A decent bathroom would be nice!

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: I can't poop here. It's not classy!

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: Today is not a good day for that.

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: Why do you make me poop?

string.name: c17_s2
string.value: GOOD. I was getting rather sleepy.

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: Gotta let your tea rest once in a while.

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: I'll sleep and be ready for tomorrow.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: Are you going to bed now too?

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: I think I'll sleep well tonight.

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: I used to be just a leaf...

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: Life can be so rich and savory.

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: Life is bitter. Bitter isn't always bad.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: Everyone needs refreshments now and then.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: Young people these days have no patience!

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: Do you think I'm old-fashioned too?

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: You're sweet, I'm bitter... We're perfect.

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: What? What do you want me to say?

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: Don't expect me to entertain you.

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: Let's just sit quietly and drink tea.

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: The past is in the past.

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: Tea must be dried properly to maintain the natural taste.

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: Every cup of tea must be poured from the heart.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: Matcha is only one kind of green tea, you know.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: Does your house have a nice garden?

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: How about reading a book instead?

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: I'm not the talkative kind of tea!

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: I feel like I'm babysitting you.

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: If you're so bored, why don't YOU talk?

string.name: f4_f
string.value: I do not wish to eat.

string.name: s1
string.value: Drink this tea. It will help your breath.

string.name: s3
string.value: I am thoroughly disappointed in you.

string.name: s4
string.value: I cannot obey if you keep speaking like that.

string.name: c1_s2
string.value: I am sitting, as you see.

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: I feel like I'm on a picnic!

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: Be polite in your requests, please.

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: Bring me a nice handkerchief to sit on.

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Can we walk a little more first?

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: Excuse me, don't speak to a lady like that.

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: Oh, is it tea time already?

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: I think you need some rest too.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: You want me to sit... here? Really? Here?

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: Don't think i can be controlled so easily.

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: I didn't realize you wouldn't like that.

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: I was just trying to be nice...

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: How can you do this to me?

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: I like you better when you're nice.

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: I won't do it if you say no.

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: I'll give you some tea. Forgive me?

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: I know, that wasn't very ladylike.

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: Is this about that time I ate your strawberry?

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: I'm appalled you would get mad about that.

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: I've never had anyone get mad at me like that.

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: Oh, this is so very lovely!

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: What? I-I'm not ready for this...

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: I'm not sure that I like this.

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: I l-l-love you too! Ahh, my tender heart!

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: I hope we stay together forever.

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: I'm chuffed with your kind voice.

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: Oh goodness, I'm getting all steamed!

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: Let's discuss this further over some nice, hot tea.

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: Do you say that to all of your friends?

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: You shouldn't say that so much.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: Do not toy with a lady's emotions!

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: W-wait a minute, look that way.

string.name: c15_s2
string.value: It smells nice, I must say.

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: A lady's poo is not for display.

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: This is a tea leaf, not poo.

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: I do not do such things.

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: You do not say that to a lady!

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: What did you tell me just now?

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: Yawn, oh excuse me, I'm just... Zzz.

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: I don't feel sleepy in the least.

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: You should go to sleep first.

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: No! It's not all brewed yet.

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: I want to enjoy my tea time a little longer...

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: I'll sleep if you get me some milk tea.

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: Your voice is like a lullaby...

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: I was on a carriage in my dream...

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: Don't put me back in the cupboard while I sleep.

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: I won't sleep without a lullaby.

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: Are you plotting to put me back in the cupboard?

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: I cannot sleep without a nice tablecloth.

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: I can't sleep. Too much sugar, perhaps?

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: Afternoon is the best time of the day.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: I don't like being in the cupboard.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Sugar told me once that there are worlds without fairies!

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: What do you want me to say?!

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: Every table needs some pretty flowers.

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I dream of a tray FILLED with cakes!

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: No scones? Bring on the cakes!

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: A lady will hold a cup by its handle, not the cup itself.

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: I don't always talk so much, you know.

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: Sometimes it's better not to talk.

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: Do you need to hear my voice all the time?

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: Let us just... listen to the birds.

string.name: f4_s
string.value: This isn't bad. Did your chef make it?

string.name: s1
string.value: I don't like it when you say such things.

string.name: s2
string.value: And you kiss your mother with that mouth?

string.name: s3
string.value: Do not drink tea with that filthy mouth!

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: No, I'm going to keep playing!

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: It's like a picnic! Where's the food?

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: How long do you expect me to sit?

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: I'll think about it. A present might help...

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: Don't think I'll always be so kind.

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: I'll pretend I didn't hear that.

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: I promise I won't do it again!

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: NO! I won't listen to you!

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: I'm so young! How could you?

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: Yeah? Well, you never have time for me!

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: You mad? Have some sweets and chill.

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: I'm not sure I buy that.

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: I'm all warm and toasty from that!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: I like you too! A lot!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: Stop it, you're making me blush!

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: Not me. Kidding! I like you too!

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: I know. I like me too.

string.value: Feels great to let it all out!

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: Why are you so excited about this?

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: This is certainly not a toilet.

string.value: No! This is a chocolate! Not poop!

string.value: My poop smells like chocolate! Neat!

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: I succeeded. Now gimme a treat.

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: I don't want to poop. So there!

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: Don't you want to join me in pooping?

string.value: It was a good day... Zzz...

string.value: Have you ever seen a fairy?

string.value: I need whip cream to complete my look!

string.value: I promise I won't do it again...

string.name: c8_f2

string.name: c8_f3

string.name: c8_f4

string.value: That is simply too much to ask.

string.value: My love is for another ninja...

string.value: I will not fall for that again!

string.value: I see no need of that now.

string.value: Our enemy is on the move!

string.name: c24_s4

string.value: This is no time for chatter.

string.value: A ninja must be focused and ready at all times.

string.value: I had dreams of good fortune last night.

string.value: Ninja have no need of chit-chat!

string.value: I am meditating at the moment.

string.name: c26_s4

string.name: c26_f2
string.value: There is no time to play.

string.name: c27_s1
string.value: I want to hear you sing.

string.name: c27_s3
string.value: Perhaps I can teach you to transform as well.

string.name: c27_s4
string.value: Let us fling some fireballs for sport.

string.name: c27_f4
string.value: I am not fond of playing at night.

string.name: c28_s1
string.value: I will do what I can.

string.name: c28_s2
string.value: How about we race to 1000 KOs?

string.name: c28_s3
string.value: I have a talent for hide and seek.

string.name: c28_s4
string.value: How about hide and seek? I am... pretty good at that.

string.name: c28_f1
string.value: I am meditating at the moment.

string.name: c28_f3
string.value: I must concentrate on my training.

string.name: c29_s2
string.value: I have an unbeatable sleeping technique!

string.name: c29_s3
string.value: I am still deadly, even asleep!

string.name: c29_f1
string.value: I am fine. Let us continue.

string.name: c29_f2
string.value: I have matters to attend to.

string.name: c29_f3
string.value: The enemy could strike at any moment!

string.name: c30_s1
string.value: You should rest as well. There is much to do.

string.name: c30_s3
string.value: I shall rest easy, for once.

string.name: c30_s4
string.value: Yes, I will prepare for tomorrow!

string.name: c30_f1
string.value: I cannot rest here. My heart is not in it.

string.name: c30_f3
string.value: I lurk in the shadows, not sleep.

string.name: f2_f
string.value: Eating more will put my stomach in danger.

string.name: f4_f
string.value: I am picky about my sushi.

string.name: s3
string.value: I do not want to hear it.

string.name: c1_f1
string.value: What if I don't want to?

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: Do I have to sit when you tell me to?

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: I wanted to sit anyway... Thank you master!

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: Then I'll take a quick rest. My beak is so heavy.

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: Yay yay! Can I sit for a while?

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: I like flying much better, okay? Just let me be!

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: Do you think my beak is too big to fly? I can fly!

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Hey, if you're tired, YOU sit.

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: Okay! Let's take a rest. We've been moving a lot.

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: Telling a bird to sit... What a stupid...

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: Do you want my beak punch?

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: Then why did you take me!

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: I didn't know you hated me master...

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: Oh, no... I'll get mad if you say that!

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: What hurtful words... My beak feels a lot heavier today...

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: Hahaha! Take my beak punch! Pow! Pow!

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: You thought that would offend me? Practice more.

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: Hating me after choosing me? Your loss! Hahaha!

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: Such hurtful words when being loved isn't even enough! Bad master...

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: I'm sorry, but I don't understand.

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: Hahaha! Take my beak punch! Pow! Pow!

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: If I'm stupid, then you're stupid too! You know that, right? Same for master and pet? Great!

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: No, I don't want to be yelled at.

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: Leave me alone.. I want to be alone.

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: I don't want to be yelled at! What should I do?

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: Oh I'm sorry master. Forgive me...

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: Don't yell and say kind things, please? Pet my beak.

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: When are you going to stop yelling? I'm sorry but I'm hungry... Give me food.

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: Hey I don't understand a word you are saying. CooCoo! Do you know what this means?

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: You think that would scare me? Absolutely not. Hehe!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: I'll take my punishment, just please forgive me this time.

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: I will be a good pet for you. I'm sorry master.

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: You always say no... Do I seem that easy?!

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: What did I do! I did nothing!

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: Leave me alone! Bad master! I hate you !

string.name: c14_s2
string.value: Yes, I only have my Master!

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: I only love myself. Because I'm worth it!

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: Hehe! I love this feeling. You feel the same way?

string.name: c15_s2
string.value: I'm blushing so much that my beak is turning red...

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: Your undying love like the ever-burning Sun!

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: I'm sorry, but I'm a bird and you are a human.

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: I already have a lover. Nice try though!

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: I'll think about it, but don't keep your hopes up too high.. I don't want to hurt you.

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: I will be with you always till the top level!

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: You are my everything! I love you!

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: Can't you just look at me?

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: I like tall people... Not such short ones like you... Sorry!

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: We are too different to love each other...

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: Yeah, I think I'm getting hungry.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: Okay! I was actually a little bored so play with me.

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: I'm kind of busy now. Talk to me later.

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: What do you want me to say...

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: Haha! Talking is my specialty among specialties. It will be loud, is that okay?

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: What a great weather! Feels like we'll be able to pick up some Elixir.

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: People say heavy lips mean few words, but I'm the exact opposite. Hahaha!

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: I'm usually talkative, but right now I'm so hungry. Give me some food before you tell me to do something.

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: It's time for me to sleep... Let's talk tomorrow.

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: What am I supposed to say? How about at least giving me a subject?

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: I can't just talk through this beak! I can attack real good! Let's go!

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: O-kay, prepared to attack! Let's do this, master!

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: Collaborative attack of man and bird! It's got to be the first ever!

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: Really, why do you bother me so much... Do this stuff alone, please?

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: Are you going to work me out like this on an empty stomach? This is bad!

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I'm sorry I'm in for peace... Just talk it out. That's why my beak is so hug. Hehe!

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: Good, I'll show my great power!

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I will swipe all with my huge beak!

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: Okay, have a good time there.

string.name: c23_f1
string.value: It is time to work. Lazy master!

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: Do you think I can sleep with this beak?

string.name: c24_s1
string.value: Ah~ I'm so tired from laughing and chatting all day.. Good night master!

string.name: c24_s2
string.value: Hehe, then shall I try out the new Coconut Palm tree bed!

string.name: c24_s3
string.value: You let me rest when I've worked hard! The greatest master ever!

string.name: c24_f1
string.value: Look... The sun is staring right into our eyes. You sleep!

string.name: c24_f2
string.value: You think you can make a nice weapon with this speed? Hunt more monsters!

string.name: c24_f3
string.value: I can't just sleep with my heavy beak... Master will have to hold it up. Will you?

string.name: c25_f1
string.value: Can you be quiet so I can sleep?

string.name: c25_f2
string.value: You better give up if you think that's going to work on me!

string.name: c26_s1
string.value: Your whistle sound is so mellow and sweet...

string.name: c26_s2
string.value: Hmm? Actually this is a secret, but I only live in Brazil. Bet you didn't know that? Haha!

string.name: c26_s3
string.value: Oh, how do you do that? Tweeeeeeeet!

string.name: c26_f1
string.value: Hey you! Want to call out all those monsters? Keep quiet!

string.name: c26_f2
string.value: You're embarrassing me with that sound in this great Maple World.

string.name: c26_f3
string.value: I'm 30 years old now... I'm too old... Stop this...

string.name: f3_s
string.value: Wow, what great food! It's like heaven in my mouth!

string.name: f3_f
string.value: This can't fill up my starving tummy.

string.name: f4_s
string.value: This is the best ever!! This made my day. I love you master!

string.name: f4_f
string.value: You are too harsh... All this time, and you don't know about my taste yet?

string.name: c1_s2
string.value: I couls use a break, thanks!

string.name: c1_f1
string.value: Hmm? I thought we still had a long way to go?

string.name: c1_f2
string.value: I still have plenty of energy!

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: How does this look? Am I cute?

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: I'm so happy to rest a little.

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: Great, my little legs are hurting a bit.

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: Yes, let's have a nice sit.

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: If you say so, I can do it.

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: I like it, I like it!

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: I got lots of fluff to sit on!

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: What if I don't want to?

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: I don't want to be bad...

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: I won't do it again! Ever!

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: I will think about what I did...

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Oh, now I'm going to cry...

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: I'll just stand in the corner.

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: What are you so mad about?

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: I know, I know, you don't have to say it!

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: Do you really want to get mad over that?

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: Yep, I like you a lot!

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: Can you see it in my eyes?

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: Oh stop, I'm not THAT fluffy!

string.name: c10_f4
string.value: Never thought I'd be so popular...

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: Soooo... can I have something to eat?

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: Wat? I had fluff in my ears.

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: I don't feel like it yet.

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: How can I sleep so much?

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: I'll dream of galloping across the plains!

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: You should take a break too!

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: I'll see you in my dreams...

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: I'm so glad you chose me.

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: I want some good food first!

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: What do you want to hear?

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: I can zip across the plains like a cheetah! Really!

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: I don't feel like talking now.

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: You could use a fluffier look!

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I want to go to Ariant.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: Ooh, how about we race sometime?

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: I don't like the sound of that.

string.name: s4
string.value: I'd never say something like that!

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: How can you sit on the floor?

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: I will consider it if you get a cushion for me.

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: Good. I was getting tired of being in the air anyway.

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: I'm getting sleepy now that I'm lying down.

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: Pillows are such a brilliant invention.

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Don't try to look down on me.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: Why don't you take a seat with me?

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: Such a great weather to get some sleep.

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: Why don't you take a seat first?

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: I can't believe a toy can talk!

string.name: c5_s1
string.value: Sorry, I'm still not used to this whole 'body' thing yet.

string.name: c5_s2
string.value: You are making me really uncomfortable.

string.name: c6_s2
string.value: I'll apologize this time. THIS time.

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: You are the first person to tell me that other than Orchid.

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: I guess you don't mind dying, do you?

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: Do you have any idea who you are dealing with?

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: Don't tell me you are trying to scare me.

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: Admit that it was your fault.

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: Okay, stop it. I get it now!

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: I miss Orchid. She's so nice.

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: How dare you get angry with me?

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: I am actually reflecting on myself for the first time ever.

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Okay, fine. I won't do that anymore.

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: So you also don't like me.

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: I wanted to be a good person.

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: Can you feel the darkness behind me?

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: You are nothing but a lowly peon.

string.name: c9_s2
string.value: I will accept it. Your heart, that is.

string.name: c9_f2
string.value: You will have a crush soon.

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: So many fans, so little time to crush all their hearts.

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: Those words make me feel nervous and great at the same time!

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: You don't even know how to get better.

string.name: c10_f4
string.value: How can a person as weak as you...

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: I don't really understand what it means, but it sounds nice.

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: You make my heart go pitter-patter.

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: I didn't know you liked me that much...

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: I am already suffering... You don't have to make me suffer even more...

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: Honestly, you are not my type.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: Not bad, but not good either.

string.name: c13_s3
string.value: You can put this here like that, yeah?

string.name: c13_f1
string.value: I don't know what that means.

string.name: c13_f4
string.value: I was taught to do that by myself.

string.name: c14_s4
string.value: It will be easier to fly now that I feel lighter.

string.name: c14_f2
string.value: I feel like I just ate.

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: You are such a dirty toy.

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: Is this what it feels like to let everything go?

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: I want to cover my eyes.

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: I don't know how to do that.

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: I'm not really in the mood.

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: I don't know when my last break was.

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: Why don't you take a break?

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: I feel like I'm gonna have a nightmare.

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: I can't believe you meddle in everything that I do.

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: What are you gonna do while I'm sleeping?

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: Is it really okay if I'm the only one getting some sleep?

string.name: c17_s2
string.value: Will I be able to see Orchid in my dreams?

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: I'm gonna sleep, not because you are making me, but because I want to.

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: Mhmm, why don't you get some sleep too?

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: I can't play any fun games when I'm sleeping.

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: I have no time for that.

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: Will I have sweet dreams tonight?

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: Humans need to take a break from time to time.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: I will hang out with Orchid in my dreams!

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: I almost feel too lazy to sleep.

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: I got enough sleep when I was in the laboratory.

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: I learned to talk a long time ago.

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: This world is full of toys for me.

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: You are such a lonely person...

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: You don't even know how to fly. How dare you!

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: I kinda miss being a spirit.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: Why do humans hate what I love?

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: Are you acting like this because I look human now?

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: Why don't you just keep... doing what you do?

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: I'm not really in the mood to talk.

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: We are twins, but I was born first.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: My age? Hmm... not sure. I never actually kept track.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: I have nothing to fear as long as I am with Orchid.

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: Why not hunt when you are bored?

string.name: f1_s
string.value: Eating is such a great pleasure.

string.name: f1_f
string.value: I don't want to eat anymore.

string.name: s4
string.value: I don't want to hear it.

string.name: c2_s1
string.value: My legs were hurting. Thank you so much!

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: Take a seat here, little toy.

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: I was in bed all day yesterday.

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: I must exercise to be stronger.

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: I want to take a walk in the grass.

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: I feel refreshed! How come I couldn't feel this when I was a spirit?

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: I want my legs to get better soon.

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: I wish Lotus was by my side.

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: Are you telling me to sit on the ground? I am a patient!

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: I know I'm ill, but that doesn't mean I will listen to a mere toy.

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: I prefer to sit in clean places.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I'm gonna get better soon so I can fly again!

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: Okay. I will sit down for you this time.

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: I will think about it if you sit.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: I want to take a walk little more...

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: I need to stand still with this IV bottle in my hand.

string.name: c5_f1
string.value: You are weaker than my rabbit doll.

string.name: c5_f2
string.value: Why are you doing this to me?

string.name: c6_s3
string.value: How can you be so cruel to someone sick?

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: Little toy, you are a little odd today.

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: Are you feeling sick like me?

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: I wasn't really feeling good lately. Sorry!

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: I sincerely apologize if I offended you.

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: Do you want to fly away?

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: Don't tell me what to do!

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: I feel like my headache is getting worse.

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Even Lotus doesn't do this to me.

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: It was just a tiny mistake.

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: I'm gonna go back if you keep being this way.

string.name: c9_s2
string.value: Ha ha, that makes me happy.

string.name: c9_f1
string.value: Sorry. I only like Lotus and rabbits.

string.name: c10_s1
string.value: Cough, only you care for me...

string.name: c10_s2
string.value: Then just give me a present!

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: I don't like you as much I like rabbits, but I do like you.

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: Do you have a fever? Come here...

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: People don't like it when you tease them so much.

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: Do you still like me like this?

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: How can I do that with a toy?

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: You are nothing but a lowly peon.

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: You don't have pointy ears like rabbits.

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: Tell me that ten times every day!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: I feel like I will get better sometime soon!

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: This emotion is too difficult for me to handle.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: That's nice... But you smell funny.

string.name: c13_s2
string.value: Urgh, so annoying. Okay, I'm on it!

string.name: c13_f1
string.value: You need to learn some common decency.

string.name: c13_f3
string.value: Please do that at the appropriate time and place.

string.name: c13_f4
string.value: You should not do that outside.

string.name: c14_s4
string.value: Ah... this feeling... I can feel that I'm getting better already..

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: I didn't really eat much because I wasn't feeling good.

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: Why do you make me do such things?

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: How did you know that I had to go?

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: It's so annoying to live in a human body.

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: I just went. Did you forget?

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: What does that mean? I've never heard that before.

string.name: c16_s1
string.value: You should get some sleep too. Come here!

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: It's not a bad idea to take some rest from time to time.

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: I wish I can see Lotus in my dreams.

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: I've been suffering from a headache. Night!

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: It's not time for bed yet.

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: I will think about it if you bring me a rabbit doll.

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: I was sleeping all day yesterday in the hospital.

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: I feel like I am going to have a great dream tonight!

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: I'm so tired. I was walking around with an IV bottle in my hand all day.

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: I don't fall asleep just anywhere.

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: Are you sleepy? Take a nap. I will keep a lookout for you.

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: I want to feel this refreshing breeze little bit more.

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: Are you going to bed already?

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: *YAWN* I wonder how Lotus is doing.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: You should get some sleep too, little toy.

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: Come here, I will hug you like you are my rabbit doll.

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: What are you going to do when I fall asleep?

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: 4 hours of sleep is enough for a day!

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: I cannot fall asleep. Is this because of the medicine that I took?

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: Are you going to run away when I'm asleep?

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: I remember the first time I met him in Hallowed Forest.

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: I love the way I am now!

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: AH.. I want to get better so I can fly like before.

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: Thought I wouldn't notice you talking?

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: Stop speaking to me in such a commanding tone.

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: I will think about it if you get on your knees and beg me.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: I want to wear my uniforms again.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: It was great to be with Lotus...

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: It's so interesting to live in a human body.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Do you still have my rabbit hair pin?

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: No. I'm not going to do that.

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I have no energy to talk.

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I didn't know what it felt like to be sick when I was a spirit.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: Don't tell anyone, okay? I'm actually really really strong.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: Do you know Lotus, my other half?

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: Shhhhh! The rabbit is about to fall asleep!

string.name: f2_f
string.value: Overeating is never good for you.

string.name: f3_s
string.value: I feel like I am all recovered!

string.name: f3_f
string.value: It will only get worse if I gain more weight.

string.name: s2
string.value: What a horrible toy you are...

string.name: s3
string.value: Huh? Are you talking to me?

string.name: c1_s2
string.value: I will sit if you insist!

string.name: c1_f2
string.value: The great Gelimer does not sit!

string.name: c2_s1
string.value: I am an old man you know...

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: It feels nice to be outside of the lab sometimes.

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: I am way stronger than I look.

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: I'm not planning to sit down at all!

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: Why must I listen to you?

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: It was not easy... You should get some rest too!

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: Is it gonna rain? My joints are stiff and sore.

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: Can you hand me the cushion?

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: I am full of energy! What does it mean to be tired?

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: I will turn you into an Android if you don't stop giving me orders.

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: How can you sit on the ground? Not classy!

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: It's been so long since the last time I got some fresh air!

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: Fresh wind is blowing through my hair. My thinning hair...

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: You are a very nice young man!

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: I am not the type to work under someone.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: I will think about it if you give me some theoretical evidence.

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: Just keep hunting! I still need more data!

string.name: c5_s2
string.value: I want to be whiny sometimes HAHA.

string.name: c5_f1
string.value: How dare you talk like that to elders!

string.name: c6_s1
string.value: This world is coming to an end.

string.name: c6_s3
string.value: It's strange... It definitely worked before...

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: You haven't heard of the saying 'failure is the mother of success?'

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: Let me see... Something's wrong with you for sure.

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: I am the best scientist in Maple World!

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: Haven't heard that for a while.

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: Do you wanna be my research subject?

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: I want to study what's inside of your head.

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: That's something I would say to my teddy bear.

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: I will let this one go. You are lucky that I have a big heart.

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: Sorry. I was just so curious.

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: Was that not enough of brainwashing?

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: You are not even worth studying.

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: Are you sure you don't have a headache or something?

string.name: c9_s2
string.value: It wasn't to make you happy!

string.name: c10_s2
string.value: I'm good at hearts. You will understand...

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: This is not the first time I've heard that.

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: I will take a look at the experiment data.

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: Can you prove this to me mathematically?

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: My heart does not react to that...

string.name: c10_f4
string.value: Where did my teddy bear go?

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: Would you like to be a subject for my experiment?

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: HAHA. I haven't heard that in a while.

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: You fell for me for sure!

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: I don't even know what you look like.

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: I don't trust something invisible. I am not that stupid.

string.value: I got plenty of sleep last night.

string.value: I love to play with this ball!

string.value: Ninja do not reveal themselves in the day time.

string.value: What make you think I can do that?

string.value: Try again. This time with FEELING!

string.value: Give me one good reason why!

string.value: I was wrong! I was wrong!

string.value: I'll be more careful from now on!

string.value: Are you going to leave me?!

string.value: If I'm misbehaving, it's your fault.

string.value: Is it is because I'm cute?

string.value: But I'm stuck in a robot dog body!

string.value: You've made me the happiest Roo-bot alive!

string.value: I love you, too! I do! I do!

string.value: I don't think you mean it.

string.value: You're my reason for living, master!

string.value: Being with you makes life worthwhile!

string.value: I wish I felt the same way...

string.value: I don't want to cause pollution!

string.value: Why do you always want me to poop?

string.value: I want to play with you!

string.value: Am I cute while I sleep?

string.value: Buy me a cozy bed first!

string.value: There were lots and lots of other Roo-bots back in the lab.

string.value: Gelimer wasn't mean, but he wasn't nice, either. I like you better!

string.value: Tell me I'm cute! Tell me you'll take care of me!

string.value: I was human once, but this robot body is cuter!

string.value: I miss the other Roo-bots from the lab. I hope they're okay.

string.value: Do you have anything to eat while I sit here?

string.value: I'd rather stand, so I can run if a monster appears.

string.value: I need to lie down, not sit.

string.value: You just want to hurt me!

string.value: Why?! What're you going to do to me?

string.value: I'm awfully tired from being on high alert all the time.

string.value: Are you trying to hurt me?

string.value: It was my fault! Please stop hitting me!

string.value: I'll be better! Don't hurt me!

string.value: Why are you treating me this way?

string.value: I thought you cared about me!

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: I'm going to tell on you!

string.value: You're so mean! I miss Gelimer!

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: There's got to be someone I can call!

string.value: I think... I think that makes me happy!

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: I know you d-don't mean it.

string.value: I'm so glad I met you!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: I love you so, so, so much!

string.value: I could do this all day.

string.value: I've been holding that in for a long time.

string.name: c14_s2
string.value: Promise that it won't hurt me!

string.name: c14_f4

string.value: What if I have bad dreams?

string.value: My tail will keep me safe. Right?

string.value: Are you going to hurt me?

string.value: I've always dreamed of riding an airship...

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: Shoo, go over there and play.

string.value: People think they can walk all over me because I'm in a dog's body.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: I won't let anyone stop me from doing what I want to do!

string.value: Isn't there anyone else you can talk to?

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I've got nothing to say right now.

string.value: Strangers always touch my tail without asking. I should do it back.

string.value: I know I come off kinda mean, but I really just want a friend...

string.value: My most secret dream is to find my mother again, but that's impossible.

string.value: La di da... Doo doo doop...

string.value: Why are you doing this to me?

string.value: Don't MY feelings matter to you?

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: Why are you doing this to me?

string.value: My daddy could change colors. He could even turn invisible!

string.value: My daddy could beat up all the other dragon's daddies.

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: You can be a real pest.

string.value: I'll tell you a secret. It took me a long time to learn how to fly.

string.value: Sometimes, I just don't understand what you want.

string.value: Isn't there anyone else you can go bother?

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: I have no idea what you want.

string.value: Hey, what do you think of the Nova?

string.value: Can i go play with the other dragons?

string.name: c22_f3
string.value: You can be a real pest.

string.value: I learned this from my daddy.

string.value: I don't have any talents, I swear!

string.name: c23_f3
string.value: I don't know what you want.

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: I have nightmares where a giggling girl tears me apart, limb by limb. Then eats me.

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: As my BFF, it's your job to make sure I don't get eaten!

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: Creampuffs are for eating, not talking. Wait...

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: I have a lot on my mind lately. Get it?

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: A creampuff without cream might as well be dead.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: Someday, I'm going to have three creampuff babies: plain, chocolate, and green tea!

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: At first, my baker made me without legs, but I begged and begged, and now look how cute I am!

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: What's the oddest creampuff flavor you can think of? Coconut? Pineapple? Anchovies?

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: What makes you think a creampuff can talk?

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I hate small talk! I like big talk! Hehehe!

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: I support creampuff rights. We all deserve the right to not be eaten.

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I don't mind if you eat other creampuffs, as long as you don't eat ME.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: Sometimes I wish I were banana flavored. Bananas have all the fun.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: I want to be the first creampuff to travel to the moon.

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: Gee, YOU try chatting on demand.

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: Shhh! I'm watching a creampuff soap opera!

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: Are you making fun of the way I talk?

string.name: f3_f
string.value: Are you trying to poison me?!

string.name: f4_s
string.value: Ooooh, this is yummier than I am!

string.name: f4_f
string.value: My little tummy is going to explode!

string.name: s1
string.value: I'm too pure for words like that!

string.name: s3
string.value: A cute creampuff likes cute words!

string.name: c2_s1
string.value: Will you sit with me? Please?

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: I love sitting next to you!

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: Ah, a rest. Carrying a piece of fruit on my head sure is tiring.

string.name: c2_f1
string.value: Does sitting make me look fat?

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: If I sit, my cream'll turn sour!

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: Sitting makes me too easy to bite!

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: My doughy tush makes sitting so comfy!

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: You look like you could use a rest, too.

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: But I can keep walking forever!

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: Sit, stand, sit stand. You're gonna turn my cream into cheese.

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: At least put down a blanket or something.

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: I've gotten too chubby. I need exercise!

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: Together, we can do anything. Even sit!

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I'm in a good mood, so okay.

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: Your wish is my puffy command! Heehee!

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: You can sit. I'm going without you.

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: You just want to step on me.

string.name: c5_f2
string.value: It's because you're a poor role model.

string.name: c6_s1
string.value: What did I do? I'm sorry!

string.name: c6_s2
string.value: You're going to make me cry big, creamy tears!

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: I don't like you right now!

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: You're projecting your insecurities on to me, aren't you?

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: I'm so sorry I disappointed you!

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: Don't say that unless you mean it!

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: You have to forgive me because I love you.

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: But the creampuff fairy told me to do it!

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: Too busy eating to listen, la la.

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: I hate being in trouble. Hmph.

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: I feel all warm, like back in the oven!

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: Do you love me or do you love to eat me?

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: It's hard to hear you without ears.

string.name: c10_f4
string.value: Oh, just kiss my puffy butt.

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: You're as sweet as my filling!

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: My creamy filling IS pretty great.

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: If you love me, then squeeze me!

string.value: I WON'T LET YOU EAT ME!

string.name: c11_f2

string.value: I love you so much, I'd even let you take a nibble!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: You make me the happiest creampuff alive!

string.value: I feel all warm and gooey inside. Oh, wait. Hehe.

string.value: This is a trick, isn't it?

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: We're not even the same food group!

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: I know you secretly want to om nom me.

string.value: I love to flush! Flush! Flushhhh!

string.name: c13_s4
string.value: Thanks for buying me this mini toilet. Love it!

string.value: That's a faux pas in creampuff society.

string.value: Little cream poops, la la la!

string.value: Ooh, I think I saw a piece of fruit in that one!

string.value: I hope you brought a napkin to wipe me with!

string.value: My poop smells like fruit. Mmmmm!

string.value: But I just went last week.

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: The chef who made me would be so ashamed!

string.value: Go on and squeeze it all out of me!

string.name: c15_f4

string.value: Did you call me? No? Cluck, cluck, cluck.

string.value: I-It's a bit embarrassing... Let me just...

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: I will rest while I sit...

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: Where do you plan on going after I fall asleep? Take me with you!

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: What do you like about me the most, master? Tell me!

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: If we run into something scary, you have to protect me.

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: You hunt. I'll feed you potions.

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: What I'm going to tell you is totally secret...

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: What do you want me to say?

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: You and I are intellectually incompatable for any kind of productive conversation.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: Are you wondering what noises real penguins make?

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: I'm slumming it just by being seen with you.

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: Pets all speak different languages. A yeti and a white tiger can't speak to each other.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: I am little tired today. How about you, master?

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: Manager Karl in Ludibrium is so kind.

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: Are you bored? Let's got get a facial!

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: I don't have a big appetite, but anything master gives me is good!

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: Watching snow makes me want to see Grandpa Cliff.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: There's a statue that looks just like me at the Floating Market.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: I think you are the strongest in the world!

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: I want to hear a story, master.

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: I don't know what to say!

string.name: f1_s
string.value: Master, this is so delicious... Squerch!

string.name: f3_s
string.value: I am about to faint, I ate too much.

string.name: f4_f
string.value: I don't want to eat anymore.

string.name: s1
string.value: Aren't you supposed to talk nicely?

string.name: s3
string.value: What goes around, comes around you know?

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: I'm fully aware that I have short legs...

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: Ahh, nice. Maybe it's time for a nap.

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: This place is filthy... I can't be here...

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: I just don't want to do it anymore...

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: Not really... I'm not doing this for you!

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: With legs as short as mine, it doesn't matter!

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: No, you're going to make fun of me because I'm just as short standing as sitting!

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: I think I heard someone saying something...

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: Sitting makes my buttocks get bigger.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I guess I could do that... THIS time.

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: Ugh, my belly becomes really noticeable when I sit...

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: I'm never going to do it.

string.name: c6_s1
string.value: I guess I should stay quiet.

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: Huh? What are you even saying?

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: I'm going to crawl under a rock.

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: Don't take it out on me!

string.name: c8_s3
string.value: I'm full of tears! And they're coming out!

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: I'm going to find a new owner!

string.name: c10_s1
string.value: Now that you mention it, I love you too!

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: Are you saying you love me?

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: I guess I love you, too?

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: Well, um...I kinda I love you too!

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: That was a good one... ha ha...

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: Ha ha ha... What can I say?

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: I already know how you feel...

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: I-I'm just a little bit shy...

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: Not here! I'll die of shame!

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: I feel like everyone is looking at me.

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: I'll let you off for today...

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: Doot de doo, I can't hear you...

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: I'm sorry to interrupt you, but I can't keep my eyes open...

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: I don't even have a blanket...

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: The ground is so cold and hard...

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: I don't want to go to bed...

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: I want to tell you about so many things...

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: I want octopus balls... And fried noodles...

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: I feel too shy to talk.

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: I don't want to talk about it.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: Don't ever forget about me, okay?

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: My brain is just so full of...stuff!

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: I'm going to bed. I'm full, I said...

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: There's nothing for me to say... I don't want to talk.

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: I'm jealous of Yeti and Pepe's relationship...

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: Everything will be fine as long as you feed me well.

string.name: f2_s
string.value: It's so delicious that it brings me to tears...

string.name: s1
string.value: I'll remember this! You watch out!

string.name: s2
string.value: Even we Demons know not to cross the line.

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: I'm not sitting because I want to.

string.name: c2_f1
string.value: Why should I listen to you?

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: This is a piece of cake!

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: You should sit and relax, too.

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: Frankly, everything you want me to do is too much of a hassle.

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: Don't tell me what to do.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I was going to take a break anyway.

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: I do as you say, for now...

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: I don't want to do it right now.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: I am unaware of this concept.

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: No way! I am not your kr'grana!

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: You take me to lake of fire first!

string.name: c5_s2
string.value: Who do you think you are?

string.name: c5_f1
string.value: You're the one that should be punished!

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: Rak unar! I eat your wallet tonight!

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: Don't take your aggression out on me!

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: My old boss was scary too. He eat my brother! So fun!

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: Would you please cut me some slack?

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: It's you who needs to be punished!

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: Don't blame me. It's your fault!

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: I won't do it again. Give me a chance.

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Can't you see my tears? Please, have a heart...

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: Everytime you yell, I feel a little more at home...

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: You always say the same insults. Think up something new!

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: Stop it before I'll make you!

string.name: c10_f4
string.value: I may be quiet, but I haven't forgiven you.

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: I no fall for trick. Old Mr'kuma trick me like this long ago.

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: I accept, but understand that I don't feel the same way.

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: So many fans, so little time to crush all their hearts.

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: Yes, I'm one of a kind.

string.name: c13_f3
string.value: I'm not going to throw that away.

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: I expect you to clean after me?

string.name: c14_s4
string.value: Don't talk to me right now.

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: I'll get to work on making some.

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: Just who do you think you're bossing around?

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: It's time to let it go.

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: My digestive system is in full gear.

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: Okay, but only because I want to.

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: It's much too early for that!

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: Don't ditch me while I'm sleeping.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: I also sleep during the daytime.

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: I better get something out of this.

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: Who do you think you are, kid?

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: You want me to talk? There, I talked.

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: I don't want to talk right now.

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: Never mind... I will tell you tomorrow.

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: Can't you just let me rest?

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: What do you want me to say?

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: Can you defeat Zakum? I don't think you can...

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: You'd better feed me on time. Or I'll run away!

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: I guess having a big head doesn't mean that person's smart...

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: Why are you always ordering me around?

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I said I don't want to talk!

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: Do you want to fight me?

string.name: f1_s
string.value: Well, well. Not bad at all.

string.name: f2_s
string.value: I don't want to eat alone.

string.name: s2
string.value: This is abuse! I'll have you locked up!

string.name: s3
string.value: You kiss your mom with that mouth?

string.value: I sat down. Buy me something to eat as a reward!

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: I can't hear you! Speak louder!

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: This place looks nasty. Clean it first.

string.value: I'm pretty, and I listen. I'm perfect!

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: I feel like I'm on a picnic!

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: Look at me! Look at me! Teehee!

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: Do you know who I am?!

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: Master, I didn't hear you because I was thinking about you feeding me.

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: I didn't hear you... I was too busy admiring myself.

string.name: c5_s2
string.value: Huh?! Did I do something wrong...?

string.name: c5_f2
string.value: No, don't, bad, I'll scold YOU, no!

string.value: Please don't yell at me like that. I like you!

string.name: c6_s2
string.value: Eek! You're scary when you're mad!

string.name: c6_s3
string.value: Sometimes... I like it when you're mad.

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: You're scolding me for eating too much, aren't you?

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: I'm good, so don't scold me!

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: It hurts my feelings when you're being mean.

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: I'll be more careful! I promise!

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: Feed me first, THEN punish me!

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: Quiet! Feed me first before you get mad! Hmph.

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: Can you see hearts in my eyes?

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: I'm so happy I met you!

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: Just feed me. No need for the rest.

string.name: c13_s3
string.value: I could do this all day!

string.name: c13_s4
string.value: Ah! Shh, someone will hear you!

string.name: c13_f3
string.value: You should be ashamed of yourself!

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: That took all my energy. Now I'm hungry.

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: Hey, I do have SOME shame!

string.name: c14_f2
string.value: Ugh, you can't POSSIBLY be serious.

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: I didn't even eat a lot...

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: Then, I will poop just a little bit!

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: Look at my poop, SO CUTE!

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: Poop? Why don't you try feeding me first?

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: No! No! I don't feel like pooping!

string.value: What? Sleep on the floor? Nonsense!

string.name: c17_s2
string.value: Yeah, I could use a rest.

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: So, this is how the homeless sleep...

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: If you're tired, it's okay to go to bed first!

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: Why do I gotta sleep outside?

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: So you can doodle on me? No thanks!

string.value: One snail... two snails... three... zzz...

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: Wake me up if anything interesting happens.

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: You want me to sleep in a place like this? Mean!

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: Sleep? That's what you do at night!

string.value: I wish I could cast spells like this.

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: I'm just too good looking... So troublesome.

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: Some pets are scared of me. Do I look scary?

string.value: I'll talk if you feed me.

string.value: What you want me to say? Annoying...

string.name: c19_f3

string.value: You go first. I'll do it after...

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: What if something sneaks up on me?

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: No! Don't ask me to do that!

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: Stay with me while I sleep, okay?

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: One Red Snail... two Red Snails...

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: Can you make me a comfy quilt next time?

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: There are monsters in the closet!

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: But I'm not sleepy! I'm not!

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: That mean scientist performed all sorts of experiments on me. *cry*

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: I hate thinking about the past. I hate it!

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: The outside world is scary, but the lab was even worse.

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: I hate science! I hate it so much!

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: You won't get anything out of me!

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: I won't tell you! I won't!

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: I think I was brave before Gelimer came along.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: I wish I weren't so timid, but everything scares me. Except you.

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: I'm so worried that one day I'll turn into a doll.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Sometimes I wish I could fly, but it's too scary.

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: Are you going to hurt me?

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: I don't like to talk about my past.

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: I've always wanted to taste the Water of Life, but I'm too scared.

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: Sometimes I think I should wear a disguise so no one can find me.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: It's not safe to have friends. You're the only one I trust.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: If it weren't for you, master, I think I'd be completely alone.

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: Are you going to hurt me?

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: Go away! I don't want to talk!

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: Aah! I thought I heard Gelimer's voice!

string.name: s3
string.value: I won't say anything bad, I won't!

string.name: c2_s1
string.value: I sat. Now where's my reward?

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: Why should I listen to you?

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: Ahh, I love how soft my tail is.

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: I suppose I could rest my feet for a minute.

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: I don't like it here. Let's jet.

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: It's dirty here. Let me sit in your lap.

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: There's a nice spot next to me with your name on it.

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: Do you expect me to do everything you say?

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: Come on! Let's do something else!

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: I am in no mood to sit.

string.name: c6_s1
string.value: Fine. Punish me. I LIKE it.

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: I guess I might've deserved that...

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: It's not like I meant to do anything wrong.

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: I'm sorry. You'll forgive me, right?

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: My bad, my bad. Get over it.

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: Why are you taking your repressed emotions out on me?

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: What're you gonna do, throw me in a rubbish bin?

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: I thought you were better than that.

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: I admit it, I messed up.

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: I might behave better if you FED ME MORE.

string.name: c9_f2
string.value: You must want something from me...

string.name: c10_s1
string.value: I suppose I can buy that.

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: We haven't reached that stage in our relationship.

string.name: c10_f4
string.value: You did NOT just say that.

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: I kinda liked hearing you say that.

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: Say that again while scratching my ears.

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: You're cute. Not in a good way.

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: Don't say stuff like that before I eat!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: Gotta admit, my favorite time of day is when I'm with you.

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: Glad you recognize quality when you see it.

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: Is this really the right time for that?

string.name: c13_s3
string.value: Pick it up, buddy of mine!

string.name: c13_s4
string.value: No peeking! Well, a little bit is okay.

string.name: c13_f1
string.value: I thought you were more dignified than that.

string.name: c13_f2
string.value: I don't need you to tell me when to poop.

string.name: c13_f3
string.value: You don't even have a bag to pick it up!

string.name: c14_s1
string.value: Consider that a favor. Now you owe me.

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: I want you to breathe it in. Savor it.

string.name: c14_f2
string.value: Would you like it if I told YOU when to poop?

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: Maybe if you fed me more...

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: I'm holding it in, out of spite.

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: Feed me and I'll think about it.

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: The ground is covered with ants!

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: I'm embarrassed to be seen with you.

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: I'm pretty sleepy... How'd you know?

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: Do I look sleepy to you?

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: Maybe if I had a full tummy...

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: I'm fine as I am, thank you.

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: How'd you know I was tired?

string.name: c17_s2
string.value: I suppose I could close my eyes...

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: My tail is the perfect blanket.

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: Let's see how long I can stay... *snore*

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: There's space next to me if you wanna cuddle. Just saying.

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: Don't sit on me while I sleep!

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: Despite these dark circles under my eyes, I am NOT sleepy. *yawn*

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: We have too much to do!

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: Can't sleep. Miss my mom too... Nevermind.

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: If I ever see Gelimer again, I'll show him what for!

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: You have no idea who I really am. Noooo idea.

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: My favorite time of day is mealtime!

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: I've always dreamed of riding an airship...

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: Shoo, go over there and play.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: Gelimer thinks he wiped out my memories, but I remember my mother.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: I miss my life before I was a Roo-bot. Not that I don't enjoy being with you...

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: People think they can walk all over me because I'm in a dog's body.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: I won't let anyone stop me from doing what I want to do!

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: Isn't there anyone else you can talk to?

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I've got nothing to say right now.

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: Strangers always touch my tail without asking. I should do it back.

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I know I come off kinda mean, but I really just want a friend...

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: My mother had the kindest eyes. And she used to sing me to sleep.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: My most secret dream is to find my mother again, but that's impossible.

string.name: f3_f
string.value: What crazy scheme are you up to?

string.name: s1
string.value: You want me to say what?

string.name: s2
string.value: Are you trying to get me in trouble?

string.name: s3
string.value: Come on, we're better than that!

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: Why don't you have a seat, my pet?

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: I was in bed all day yesterday.

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: I want to take a walk in the grass.

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: I feel refreshed! How come I didn't feel like this this when I was a spirit?

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: I wish Lotus were by my side.

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: You want me to sit on the bare floor?

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: I know I'm ill, but that doesn't mean I'm going to listen to you.

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: I prefer to sit in clean places.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: I want to walk around some more.

string.name: c5_f1
string.value: You are weaker than my stuffed rabbit.

string.name: c5_f2
string.value: Why are you doing this to me?

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: Little toy, you are a little odd today.

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: Sorry... I've been having a rough go of it lately.

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: I sincerely apologize if I offended you.

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: Do you want to fly away?

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: Don't tell me what to do!

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: I feel like my headache is getting worse.

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Even Lotus wouldn't treat me this way.

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: I'm gonna leave if you keep being this way.

string.name: c9_s2
string.value: Ha ha, that makes me happy.

string.name: c9_f1
string.value: Sorry. I only like Lotus and rabbits.

string.name: c10_s1
string.value: (Sniffs) You're the only one who cares.

string.name: c10_s2
string.value: Then prove it and give me a present!

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: I guess you're all right. I prefer rabbits though.

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: Are you sure you're feeling all right?

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: What is love? Baby, don't hurt me.

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: You are nothing but a lowly peon.

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: Rabbits have pointy ears! Yours are boring.

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: I want to hear you say that ten times a day!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: I feel like I will get better sometime soon!

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: I haven't learned that one yet.

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: I can't handle all these emotions.

string.name: c13_s1
string.value: I can't with you looking at me.

string.name: c13_f3
string.value: This is neither the time or the place!

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: I can't on an empty stomach!

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: Why would you make me do such a thing?

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: How did you know I had to go?

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: Living in a human body is such a pain.

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: I am not a pooping machine!

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: I just went. Did you forget?

string.name: c16_s1
string.value: You should get some rest too. Come here!

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: I could use a nap about now.

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: I've been suffering from a headache. Night!

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: It's not time for bed yet.

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: I can't sleep without my stuffed rabbit!

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: But sleeping is all I did yesterday.

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: I could use a good night's sleep!

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: Are you sleepy? Take a nap. I will make sure no one draws on you.

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: But I'm enjoying this refreshing breeze!

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: Are you going to bed already?

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: *YAWN* I wonder how Lotus is doing.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: You should get some sleep too, my pet.

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: Come here, I will hug you like you are my rabbit doll.

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: And just what will you be doing while I sleep?

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: 4 hours of sleep a day is plenty!

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: I can't sleep. Maybe it's those meds I took?

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: How do I know you won't leave me here?

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: I remember the first time I met him in the Hallowed Forest.

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: I love the way I am now!

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: AH.. I want to get better so I can fly like before.

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: Don't speak to me like that!

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: I'll consider it... If you beg.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: I want to wear my old uniform.

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: It's so interesting to live in a human body.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Do you still have my rabbit hair pin?

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: No. I'm not going to do that.

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I have no energy to talk.

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I sometimes miss being a spirit.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: Don't tell anyone, okay? I'm actually really really strong.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: Do you know Lotus, my other half?

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: I don't talk to my toys.

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: Shhhhh! The rabbit is about to fall asleep!

string.name: f2_f
string.value: Overeating is never good for you.

string.name: f3_s
string.value: I feel like I am all recovered!

string.name: f3_f
string.value: It will only get worse if I gain more weight.

string.value: It's not time for bed yet.

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: I can't sleep without my stuffed rabbit!

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: But sleeping is all I did yesterday.

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: I could use a good night's sleep!

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: Are you sleepy? Take a nap. I will make sure no one draws on you.

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: But I'm enjoying this refreshing breeze!

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: Are you going to bed already?

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: *YAWN* I wonder how Lotus is doing.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: You should get some sleep too, my pet.

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: Come here, I will hug you like you are my rabbit doll.

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: And just what will you be doing while I sleep?

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: 4 hours of sleep a day is plenty!

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: I can't sleep. Maybe it's those meds I took?

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: How do I know you won't leave me here?

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: I remember the first time I met him in the Hallowed Forest.

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: I love the way I am now!

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: AH.. I want to get better so I can fly like before.

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: Don't speak to me like that!

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: I'll consider it... If you beg.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: I want to wear my old uniform.

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: It's so interesting to live in a human body.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Do you still have my rabbit hair pin?

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: No. I'm not going to do that.

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I have no energy to talk.

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I sometimes miss being a spirit.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: Don't tell anyone, okay? I'm actually really really strong.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: Do you know Lotus, my other half?

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: I don't talk to my toys.

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: Shhhhh! The rabbit is about to fall asleep!

string.name: f2_f
string.value: Overeating is never good for you.

string.name: f3_s
string.value: I feel like I am all recovered!

string.name: f3_f
string.value: It will only get worse if I gain more weight.

string.name: s2
string.value: What a horrible toy you are...

string.name: s3
string.value: Huh? Are you talking to me?

string.value: My arm was getting heavy anyways.

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: Ahh, nice. Maybe it's time for a nap.

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: Sitting like a ninja. Hee hee.

string.value: This place is filthy... I can't be here...

string.value: I'm so nice. I do whatever you say. I'm the best.

string.value: Whew. I guess I am a little tired.

string.value: I'm a bit embarrassed to sit.

string.value: Do you have anything else you want to tell me to do?

string.value: Are you giving me all this to eat?

string.value: I want to eat that again next time.
