string.value: Why don't you eat this on your own?

string.name: f4_s
string.value: Thank you for taking care of me.

string.name: f4_f
string.value: How do you expect me to eat this?

string.name: s1
string.value: How can you say that? You really have no class, do you?

string.name: s2
string.value: How can you use a word like that? Sheesh, you're really exhausting!

string.name: s3
string.value: How do you not know that's a bad word?

string.name: s4
string.value: I don't want to put a word like that in my mouth!

string.name: c2_s1
string.value: Landed too hard. Bruised my butt.

string.name: c2_f1
string.value: Ah... I'm so hungry... I can't hear anything...

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: I want to do something else...

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: Come on, take a seat and have a chat.

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: I can't hear you, I can't hear you!

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: I will wait here and have some juice.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: You should come over here. Next to me.

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: It's the perfect time to rest!

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: I'm going to get some sleep.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: Ahh, I'm sleepy. Can't hear you...

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: You can't always get what you want.

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: I don't like being ordered around!

string.name: c6_s1
string.value: I didn't do it on purpose...

string.name: c6_s3
string.value: I know I messed up, but you still have to feed me, okay?

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: I'm sorry! I won't eat dinner tonight...

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: Keep scolding and I'll run away!

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: I don't understand what I did wrong!

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: Hey, relax! I was just messing around!

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: I'm going to assume that you said that because you love me...

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: I'm gonna have to punish you...

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: Why do you hit me? What did I do wrong?

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Please calm down. I get it now.

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: Be nice to me! Please! I'm sorry!

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: Why are you only yelling at me?

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: Nope, not gonna feel bad! I'm gonna BE bad!

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: Do you really have to make me mad!?

string.name: c9_f2
string.value: Do you really have to make me mad!?

string.name: c10_s2
string.value: Always good to have your ear!

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: I'm so happy. Say it again, please?

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: You love just me, right? Just me!

string.name: c10_f1
string.value: Not just anyone can earn my love!

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: You aren't supposed to joke around like that.

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: You shouldn't say such things like that!

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: That's good. We are partners, after all.

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: Absolutely! I totally feel the same way.

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: You are you, and and I am me, and that is all we'll ever be.

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: A tasty morsel is more precious than any words you could say.

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: This is the happiest moment of my life!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: Can you see hearts in my eyes?

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: You're the strongest, bestest person I know.

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: Promise to love me forever and ever?

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: How many pets have you had before me?

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: If you keep saying that, I will just run away!

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: I love you like family, too!

string.name: c13_f3
string.value: Who do you think I am?

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: You can't order me to do everything!

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: Oh, I feel so much better! Are you going to poop, too?

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: How am I supposed to go when I don't have to?

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: You want me to do that HERE?!

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: You're not gonna run away while I sleep, right?

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: How can I sleep when I'm not sleepy?

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: You sleep. I'll take first watch.

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: I don't want to sleep yet.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: Have some wonderful dreams! Dream of having billions of mesos!

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: If you want me to sleep, I'll sleep!

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: What do you want to hear?

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: You want to talk? Then feed me!

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: I don't know anything about that.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: I want to play some games!

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: Aren't you curious... about what the Maple Admin looks like without her hat?

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: I can't talk to other pets. We don't speak the same language.

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: My throat still hurts from talking earlier...

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: Have you ever seen a Crimson Balrog in real life?

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I wanna become stronger! Like a Crimson Balrog!

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: You better not cry, old man Cliff is coming to town!

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: I want to try some unique cuisine!

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: I don't like to talk that much.

string.name: f1_s
string.value: Heh heh, this is my favorite!

string.name: f1_f
string.value: I don't want to eat any more.

string.name: f2_s
string.value: You sure take good care of me!

string.name: f3_f
string.value: I'm gonna get fat if I eat any more...

string.name: s1
string.value: Mind your manners. You embarrass me.

string.name: s2
string.value: You want me to say what?

string.name: s3
string.value: I'd never say something like that!

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: Why don't you have a seat, my pet?

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: I was in bed all day yesterday.

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: I want to take a walk in the grass.

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: I feel refreshed! How come I didn't feel like this this when I was a spirit?

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: I wish Lotus were by my side.

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: You want me to sit on the bare floor?

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: I know I'm ill, but that doesn't mean I'm going to listen to you.

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: I prefer to sit in clean places.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: I want to walk around some more.

string.name: c5_f1
string.value: You are weaker than my stuffed rabbit.

string.name: c5_f2
string.value: Why are you doing this to me?

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: Little toy, you are a little odd today.

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: Sorry... I've been having a rough go of it lately.

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: I sincerely apologize if I offended you.

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: Do you want to fly away?

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: Don't tell me what to do!

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: I feel like my headache is getting worse.

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Even Lotus wouldn't treat me this way.

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: I'm gonna leave if you keep being this way.

string.name: c9_s2
string.value: Ha ha, that makes me happy.

string.name: c9_f1
string.value: Sorry. I only like Lotus and rabbits.

string.name: c10_s1
string.value: (Sniffs) You're the only one who cares.

string.name: c10_s2
string.value: Then prove it and give me a present!

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: I guess you're all right. I prefer rabbits though.

string.value: Are you sure you're feeling all right?

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: What is love? Baby, don't hurt me.

string.value: You are nothing but a lowly peon.

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: Rabbits have pointy ears! Yours are boring.

string.value: I want to hear you say that ten times a day!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: I feel like I will get better sometime soon!

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: I haven't learned that one yet.

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: I can't handle all these emotions.

string.value: I can't on an empty stomach!

string.name: c14_f3

string.value: Living in a human body is such a pain.

string.name: c15_f3

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: I wonder how my friends are doing.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: I heard there's a really neat place called the Spirit Tree! Wanna check it out sometime?

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: Those Rock Spirits are really cute, don't you think?

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: I'm so glad we found each other.

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: What do you want to know?

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I'm cuter than the others, right?

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: Sure, let's talk! I love the sound of my own voice!

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: Ha! Your belly is bigger than mine.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: You won't let me turn into a doll, will you?

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: Ugh, can we at least talk about something important, like my favorite food?

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: Stop telling me to do stuff. It's getting annoying.

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: I know we're super close friends and all, but you're getting a bit clingy...

string.name: f1_f
string.value: Love does not directly result in yummy food. Where's the yummy food?

string.name: f2_s
string.value: You must be a gourmet chef. Your food is always so tasty!

string.name: f2_f
string.value: Are you trying to fatten me up? You're not a witch, are you? Do you own a candy house?

string.name: f3_s
string.value: Right as my tummy started to rumble, you gave me food. Thanks!

string.name: f3_f
string.value: Any more food, and I might pop!

string.name: f4_s
string.value: If I could eat every minute of every day, I would!

string.name: f4_f
string.value: No, I'm full! I really like food, but I'm full!

string.name: s2
string.value: Do you need to rinse your mouth out with soap?

string.name: s4
string.value: Why would you even say something like that?!

string.name: c1_s2
string.value: Butt on floor! Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle!

string.name: c2_s1
string.value: Oh, I'm gonna sit. You just watch. It'll be the best sitting you've ever seen!

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: My butt is in full contact with the floor.

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: I did it! Now tell me what a great pet I am!

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: I sat down! Don't you want to clap for me?

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: My tooshie can only handle so much sitting in a day.

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: Okay, but if I can't get back up, I'm blaming you.

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: I'll sit, but you have to promise not to laugh when I wiggle my way back up.

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: Can I sit forever while you wait on me hand and foot?

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: I think I'll lie down and take a nap while I'm at it.

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: But if I sit, I won't want to get up.

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: Are you questioning my ability to stand?

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: Standing keeps me more alert. I'd rather do that.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I sat down! Gimme praise! Gimme treats! Give me everything!

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: Cookies would be nice right about now.

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: I just got up! I'm not a machine!

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: But what if I sit on a bug? OH! What if the bug sits on me?!

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: The ground is dirty. I can't get dirty. I don't like being dirty.

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: I don't take orders from anyone!

string.name: c6_s2
string.value: It's not fair! You yell at me all the time!

string.name: c6_s3
string.value: I can't keep the tears away anymore...

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: You're super scary when you're mad...

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: Some people know how to be more constructive about their anger. You should try it.

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: How could you do this to me?

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: How can you be mad at something as adorable as I am?

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: Every time you get mad, I just want to run away.

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: It's like you go out of your way to make me feel icky.

string.name: c7_s3
string.value: Calm down! I promise we can fix this!

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: You get mad at me so easily.

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: I can be mean too, you know? I just choose not to.

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: Getting angry and yelling about stuff only hurts you.

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: You must think I'm a pushover! I don't have to take that!

string.name: c8_s1
string.value: Aw, you used to think it was cute when I misbehaved.

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Violence and anger don't solve anything!

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: I guess I made a mistake. I'm sorry.

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: I get in trouble all the time. It doesn't even phase me anymore.

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: If all you're going to do is get mad at me all the time, I'll just leave.

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: If you keep bothering me, I'll get my friend Yeti to help me.

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: Why can't you leave me alone?

string.name: c9_s1
string.value: I wish you could love me even more!

string.name: c9_s2
string.value: Do you think my wish for you to love me more will come true?

string.name: c9_f2
string.value: Are you sure you meant me?

string.name: c10_s2
string.value: You have no idea how happy I am right now!

string.name: c10_f3
string.value: I can't hear you! Doo dee doo!

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: That means so much to me!

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: Of course you do! I love you too!

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: I'll pretend I didn't hear that...

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: Say it once more, with feeling!

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: I'm so glad! That makes me feel so special!

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: Ugh! You think you could save the mushy stuff until after I've eaten?

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: I'm so cute, you could love me twice as much as anyone else!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: You LOVE me! You LOVE me! You said you LOVE me!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: I always knew I was irresistible.

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: But do you love me more than anything else in the world?

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: Aren't you going to shower me with chocolate and flowers?

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: I'm pretty high-maintenance. Are you sure?

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: You think you could say that again while presenting me with tasty food?

string.name: c12_f4
string.value: Did I hear you right? Hang on, let me clean my ears first...

string.name: c13_s2
string.value: Do you maybe have some fiber to help things along?

string.name: c13_s3
string.value: Unnngh... Nope. I'll have to wait until the opportune moment.

string.name: c13_f2
string.value: Why are you so keen to make me poop?

string.name: c13_f3
string.value: I don't want to! It's gross!

string.name: c13_f4
string.value: You gonna make arts and crafts with it?

string.name: c14_s1
string.value: Do I have to do it right now? What would I clean up with?

string.name: c14_s2
string.value: Daww! Look at that! Even my poop is cute!

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: Would you help me find a good spot?

string.name: c14_s4
string.value: Hrrrrgh! Hnnnngh! I don't think it's supposed to be this hard.

string.name: c14_f2
string.value: Of all the things I could do for you, this is what you want?

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: Too late! Already did! And now you get to figure out where!

string.name: c15_s1
string.value: If I try to poop but nothing comes out, does it still count?

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: Just... Make sure nobody's looking, okay?

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: How can I poop rainbows if you won't feed me sprinkles?

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: Not yet. I've got to work up a really smelly one first.

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: Do you have some weird fascination with poop?

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: You act like I poop just to please you.

string.name: c16_s1
string.value: Yaaaawn! All this talk about sleep is making me sleepy.

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: Is the world put on pause when I go to sleep? How else do you get along without me?

string.name: c16_s4
string.value: That's a good idea. I could really use some shuteye.

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: You sleep first. I'll stand guard and contemplate the meaning of my existence.

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: Telling me to go to sleep doesn't automatically make me tired.

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: That's not happening! I just drank a bunch of tea!

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: I'm gonna play instead! You should too!

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: Have you heard about those new ice block pillows? They're all the rage.

string.name: c17_s2
string.value: I couldn't be more sleepy if I had just read an entire encyclopedia!

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: This does seem like a good place to take a nap.

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: I'm all cozy and comfy, and my belly is full. Time for a nice nap.

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: My rumbling tummy is keeping me wide awake.

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: Why? You're not going to run away or something, are you?

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: I don't think I heard that right. You want me to sleep right now?

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: Wow, you figured me out. I'm a major sleepyhead.

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: A nap would be perfect right about now.

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: Even the best of us need a good night's rest to be helpful!

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: Why would I sleep when there's so much to do?

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: You think I can go to sleep anywhere I please? I need comfort!

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: At least fetch me a couple of pillows. I need to be comfy!

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: I refuse to sleep! I don't need to! I'll be just fine.

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: Nah, sleep's no good. You know what would be great right now? Sushi.

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: You want to talk about how cute I am, don't you? I knew it.

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: You want to have a deep and meaningful conversation? Awesome!

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: We could talk about my favorite food. It's sushi, of course!

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: You're so great! We can talk about whatever you want!

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: I'm too lazy to talk. Just saying this is too much effort.

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: If you want to talk, you could at least come up with a good topic.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: I love being showered with attention!

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: I'm so glad we can talk any time we want!

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: I wonder what my friends are doing right now.

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Every day spent with friends is amazing!

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: Actually, I think I'd rather eat right now.

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: Don't talk to me. I'm writing my personal memoir in my mind.

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: If you want to chat, why don't we talk about this new diet you seem to have me on?

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: I heard El Nath sets a new snowfall record every year!

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: My biggest hope is that one day you and I can enjoy sushi together.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: Talking to you NEVER gets old! Well, not never, but you know what I mean.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: Let's play a game! Or eat! Or go on an adventure! All the things!

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: I'm too lazy to talk. Just saying this is too much effort.

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: What do you want me to say? My mind is a blank right now.

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: Is that how it works now? I just yap on command?

string.name: c21_f4
string.value: I'm not going to waste my singing voice on inane banter.

string.name: f1_s
string.value: I think ice cream might just be my new favorite treat.

string.name: f1_f
string.value: Looking at whatever that is kind of made me lose my appetite.

string.name: f2_s
string.value: Don't you just love munching and crunching on ice sometimes?

string.name: f2_f
string.value: I have a refined palate, which means I can't eat things like that.

string.name: f3_s
string.value: Food has so many amazing and varied flavors!

string.name: f3_f
string.value: I really want to eat more, but I'm so full. I'm not sure I can.

string.name: f4_s
string.value: Gosh, I'm glad I get to eat tasty stuff every day!

string.name: s1
string.value: Hm? What was that you said?

string.name: s2
string.value: If you keep using bad words, I'll stop listening to you.

string.name: s3
string.value: How am I supposed to respond to language like that?

string.name: s4
string.value: Bad words are for people who have puny vocabularies.

string.name: c1_s1
string.value: But my tail's in the way. Wait, do I even have a tail?

string.name: c1_f1
string.value: I've been sitting all day. I think I'll pass, thanks.

string.name: c1_f2
string.value: Sit-uations where people demand I sit are a pain in the butt.

string.name: c2_s1
string.value: Ta da! I sat! Now you can shower me with compliments.

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: You want me to put my BUTT on the GROUND?

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: I love sitting! It's such a great way to take in the world around you.

string.name: c2_f1
string.value: Can't you take me somewhere interesting first, like an ice castle?

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: Aw, don't make me sit here by myself. Why don't we visit a pretty ice castle?

string.name: c2_f3
string.value: I'm far too amazing to lounge around in a place like this.

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: Please don't make me do this here. It's uncomfortable.

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: Hm, this is more comfortable than I thought it would be.

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: We could even lie down and guess the shapes of the clouds.

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: I'm pretty, and I listen. I'm perfect!

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: I'll do it as carefully as possible.

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: I've been sitting for so long already that my butt fell asleep!

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: You're awfully bossy. You really need to give me some kind of incentive.

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: I'll pass, thanks. And I wasn't referring to gas.

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: Why do you care if I sit?

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I've been good! Do I get a treat now?

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: Can I sit right next to you forever?

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: Good idea! I was feeling a bit tired.

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: Sit? What if something bites me?

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: Oh, sorry. I didn't hear you.

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: The grass is really pokey though.

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: I don't have to do anything I don't want to!

string.name: c5_s2
string.value: Why do you make me cry?

string.name: c6_s2
string.value: I don't like it when you're mad.

string.name: c6_s3
string.value: I didn't know it was possible for you to be mad at me.

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: I'm sorry! Please don't hate me forever!

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: That's it! It's time to put on my angry face!

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: I don't know what to do! I didn't hear you AT ALL!

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: Why are you doing this to me?

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: Don't take your anger out on me.

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: I'll sit and think about what I've done.

string.name: c7_s4
string.value: I'm heartbroken knowing I disappointed you.

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: You're not a friend! You're a bully!

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: I didn't know you could be so mean!

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: I never thought you'd think so little of me!

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: I'm not c-c-crying. T-t-there's just something in my eye.

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: I know you're mad, but please don't leave me alone!

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: I'll just run away and find a nicer owner.

string.name: c9_s2
string.value: Hearing that makes me so happy!

string.name: c9_f1
string.value: You really know how to make a pet feel loved.

string.name: c9_f2
string.value: I'm so happy I could wiggle right out of my shoes! Oh wait...

string.name: c10_s1
string.value: Wow! Really?! Okay, I'm on board with that.

string.name: c10_s2
string.value: Would you believe me if I said you're the best owner ever?

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: You know just what to say to make me feel special.

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: Well, now you have to promise to say that every day.

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: Now that I think about it, I like you too.

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: You're the bee's knees! Whoa! What am I, 80 years old?

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: Now might not be the best time for that conversation.

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: I can't believe my ears! Did you really say that?

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: I'll pretend you didn't just say that.

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: You make my life so full of meaning!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: I always knew I was irresistible.

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: I see my charm has begun to work on you.

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: I guess I am kind of beautiful. I knew it! You can't resist me!

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: I'm more in the mood for a tasty treat than chatter right now.

string.name: c12_f2
string.value: I'll do whatever tricks you want, but you've got to give me treats.

string.name: c12_f3
string.value: I would very much enjoy a cookie right now, please and thank you!

string.name: c13_s1
string.value: Maybe you should read or something? This might take a while.

string.name: c13_s2
string.value: I've been holding it for a moment just like this.

string.name: c13_s3
string.value: Poof! I magically transported my poo to another dimension!

string.name: c13_s4
string.value: It's always so hard. I'm not sure I'm doing it right.

string.name: c13_f1
string.value: Ugh, I hate that word. How about we call it a funky lump?

string.name: c13_f2
string.value: I am far too elegant a creature to debase myself with such things as... poop.

string.name: c14_s2
string.value: Maybe I could drink some coffee to get things moving?

string.name: c14_s3
string.value: Ugh! It's so gross! Don't look at me!!

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: How can you do... In a place like this...

string.name: c14_f2
string.value: Not out here! I've heard there are special rooms for that.

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: Why do you think it's such a good idea to do that now?

string.name: c15_s2
string.value: I like to sing when I poop! What about you?

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: Poop, eat, sleep. Poop, eat, sleep.

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: Boo doo, bee doo, bee doo... Poop!

string.name: c15_f1
string.value: I don't like to do that where people can watch. It's creepy.

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: I won't do it. I will hold my poo in forever. Forever!

string.name: c15_f4
string.value: Really? Of all the things I can do for you, you want me to poop?

string.name: c16_s2
string.value: Did you put a spell on me? I'm falling asleep right... right... Zzz...

string.name: c16_s3
string.value: Good idea! I'm sleepier than I thought!

string.name: c16_f1
string.value: I'm not really that tired. Maybe I could read for a bit first?

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: I tried to sleep earlier, but you wanted me to talk to you!

string.name: c16_f3
string.value: I have more important things to do right now. Like daydream.

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: I'm too hungry to go to sleep!

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: The sooner you make me sleep, the sooner I wake up to bug you!

string.name: c17_s2
string.value: I only sleep on a full belly!

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: What if I just pretend I'm sleeping? Could you tell?

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: I hope I have wonderful dreams about how great you are!

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: How can you tell a cute pet like me to sleep on the streets?

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: I'm too hungry to fall asleep...

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: Wait! You can't tell me to take a nap and then leave me unprotected!

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: Play with me! Don't just put me to bed!

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: I'll try, but I can't guarantee I'll actually... Zzz...

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: All I need is a nice pillow and blanket to cuddle up with.

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: I can't just sleep all the time!

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: That was one command too many! NO!

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: No! I'd rather glare at you and pout.

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: We don't have time for sleep! There's so much to do!

string.name: c19_s1
string.value: There's no better pet than me, right?

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: You must love the sound of my voice. I'm proud of it.

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: I'm actually good at singing too. Wanna hear?

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: I want to grow up and fight monsters just like you!

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: Fine. But you have to give me 1 treat every time I talk.

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: I'm much too tired. Couldn't I nap instead?

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: I'm sleepy and grumpy. Now's not a good time to talk to me.

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: You won't get one peep outta me! Except for that one. And that one... And...

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: You know, it looks like a cushy life, but sometimes pet life is tough.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: Do you think if it's cold enough, I could make my own clouds by talking?

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: I saw a doll that looks like me... a LOT like me... What was it?

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: I want to go to El Nath with you. I heard it's covered in glittering snow.

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: You've kind of put me on the spot here. I don't know what to say.

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: I'm confused. What do you want to talk about?

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: Is this something owners normally like to do with their pets?

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: I'd love to go somewhere beautiful and snowy.

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I love snow! It makes the most interesting crunching noise when you walk in it.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: Did you know I can sing? I'm great with classic showtunes.

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: Flying is kind of an amazing skill when you think about it.

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: I'm much too tired. Couldn't I nap instead?

string.name: c21_f2
string.value: Let's go to sleep instead. I could use a good nap.

string.name: c21_f3

string.value: I lost some weight, so it's easier to sit!

string.value: Give me a reason. A tasty reason!

string.value: I don't want to do anything...

string.value: Man, it's actually pretty nice here!

string.value: The ground feels like it's going to give under my butt.

string.value: Nothing like a good sit! Except maybe a good meal...

string.value: No. I might sit on a bug!

string.value: I'm too hungry to be sitting...

string.value: I can't concentrate on that! I'm starving!

string.value: Ooh, you're lucky Cube Hamster is so patient!

string.value: Why do you do this to me?!

string.value: I can't believe you have so little faith in me!

string.value: You said you liked me before...

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: Stop, or you'll be the one in trouble!

string.value: Uh oh, you're on Cube Hamster's bad side!

string.name: c9_f2
string.value: Square up if you want to deal with me!

string.value: Cube Hamster is full of love!

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: Why are there no square hearts?!

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: Yeah, well... I love you more.

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: I just like the food! Not you!

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: We fit together so super well!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: You and me, squaring away this round world!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: I know I can count on you!

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: You thought I'd say I love you, right? You were wrong!

string.value: Don't tell me to do that.

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: I'll do it when I want!

string.value: I don't fit in bed now!

string.value: I wanna sleep next to you! Zzz...

string.value: You have to wake me up early tomorrow...

string.value: I feel like I could sleep for 3 days straight...

string.value: Sleep? I don't know the meaning of the word!

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: I won't sleep. Stop trying to make me sleep.

string.value: Bring me a pillow and comforter, then.

string.value: Let's talk about food! I love food!

string.value: I'm the cutest, right? Not off-base with this?

string.value: I'm not gonna make a peep.

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: I'm Cube Hamster, not Chat Hamster!

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: I'm gonna stuff my face 'till I can't talk!

string.value: I don't know how to talk!

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: What do you want to hear from me?

string.value: I'm the happiest when I'm eating!

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I want some seasoned short ribs today.

string.value: Okay! Er, what should we talk about?

string.value: We always talk about food. I like that!

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: Can't you see how tired I am?

string.value: I'm stuffed... I don't want to eat anymore.

string.value: You're not feeding Cube Hamster THAT, are you?

string.value: You shouldn't say things like that!

string.value: Well, it doesn't seem like a great idea, but I gues so.

string.value: I sat, because I WANTED to sit, not because you told me to.

string.value: Is there really a difference between standing and sitting?

string.value: I hope no one notices I'm here... Eep!

string.value: Um, can I even do that? I kind of already am...

string.value: Really? Me? The worst thing I could possibly do is sit on the ground.

string.value: Why would you ask something like that of me?

string.value: Hey! Sitting or standing, my height doesn't change!

string.value: Whew. I guess I am a little tired.

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: Oops! I farted when I sat!

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: I sat, I sat! Don't you want to sit with me?

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: Why?! You don't even feed me!

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: You're just making fun of me, because I don't have a butt!

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: No way! I bet you won't even help me get back up!

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: You're so annoying. All you do is boss me around.

string.value: I can behave once in a while.

string.value: Fine, but I'm not getting back up again.

string.value: What if I turn into a pancake?

string.value: I don't want to get all dusty and gross.

string.value: I'm not feeling particularly obedient right now.

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: It may not look like it, but I'm busy.

string.value: I knew all those nice things you said were lies.

string.value: I'm food! How mad can I possibly make you?

string.name: c5_f2
string.value: I'm not here just so you can yell at me.

string.value: Your face gets all red and veiny when you're mad.

string.value: I'm too scared to even move! What do I do?

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: Please stop! I won't do it again!

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: Back on this again, are we?

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: What?! You wanna slice of me?!

string.value: I'm sorry! I'm sorry! Don't hurt me!

string.name: c7_f1
string.value: If you keep doing that, I'll leave. I mean it!

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: Scolding is bad! Complimenting is good!

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: If you're this mad at me, maybe I should leave...

string.value: You keep making me cry like it's a game for you!

string.name: c8_f3
string.value: Really? We're doing this here and now?

string.name: c8_f4
string.value: Get over yourself. You'd be lost without me.

string.name: c9_s2
string.value: Aw, you're so sweet when you share your feelings!

string.name: c9_f2
string.value: Oh, is it feelings time? I'll pass, thanks!

string.value: Well, SOMEbody's in a mood to spill their guts...

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: Bet you don't love me more than I love you!

string.value: Maybe if I pretend I didn't hear you, we can both forget that just happened.

string.name: c11_s1
string.value: Do you have to get all gooey? You're embarrassing me.

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: I feel silly saying it, but... I love you too!

string.value: You what? OH! Look at that really interesting cloud over there!

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: You don't know what you're saying.

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: Oh my goodness! I thought you'd never say that!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: I love you too! You take such good care of me!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: You must be the best owner in the whole world!

string.value: You'll have to take me to my thinking spot.

string.value: How could you possibly expect me to defecate on command?

string.value: How many times do I have to say no?

string.value: I'm not sure I can right now... No, wait... THERE it is.

string.value: I prefer to poop in time to the 1812 Overture.

string.value: I JUST DID! Can't you smell it? Or do I need to waggle my butt in your face?

string.name: c15_f3
string.value: I don't think I can roll my eyes any harder.

string.value: I feel so relaxed when I'm fresh from a nap.

string.value: I don't even have a blanket...

string.value: I don't want to go to bed...

string.value: I want to be the trendiest pet out there!

string.value: If I turn into a doll, please don't forget about me.

string.value: I wonder if there's bread in space...

string.value: It takes too long to fall asleep.

string.value: That activity is not part of my repertoire.

string.name: c6_f4
string.value: What did I do wrong, meow?

string.name: c7_f2
string.value: You're ugly when you're mad! And the rest of the time!

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: Look at how cute and patient I am. Nyeh!

string.name: c8_s4
string.value: You're going to make me cry...

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: I've got friends who are nicer!

string.name: c9_s1
string.value: I don't get mushy, but I like you, person.

string.name: c9_f1
string.value: You telling Cube Kitty what to do?

string.name: c9_f2
string.value: I don't like that round-headed talk!

string.name: c10_s1
string.value: You're not so bad yourself, person.

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: Okay, I guess I'll accept your love!

string.name: c10_s4
string.value: I'm happy to hear such nice words.

string.name: c10_f4
string.value: I'll pretend you didn't just say that.

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: This is all a bit much, person...

string.name: c11_f1
string.value: You poor person... No date, huh?

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: For you, person, I will be a friendly kitty!

string.name: c14_s1
string.value: Cube Kitty's poop is pixel poop!

string.name: c14_s2
string.value: I'm cute down to even my poop...

string.name: c14_s4
string.value: I can do anything and still be cute!

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: What kind of person are you?

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: You should brush up on your manners.

string.name: c15_s4
string.value: Cube Kitty is the best pooper!

string.name: c15_f2
string.value: Why would you even ask that?

string.name: c16_s1
string.value: I think I might be sleepy.

string.name: c17_s1
string.value: I can't keep my eyes open...

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: Honestly... I prefer sleeping to playing! Mrrow!

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: I have no idea what you're saying.

string.name: c17_f2
string.value: Feed me first. I'm too hungry to sleep.

string.name: c17_f3
string.value: You're not going to run off, right?

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: You don't want to see my adorable face anymore?!

string.name: c18_s3
string.value: Pretty people sleep a lot, right? Hmm... Zzz...

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: You can't sleep! You need to train!

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: No way! You're not ditching me!

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: Let's eat, and then I'll consider it.

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: Am I too cute for you, person?

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: My cuteness is becoming an issue...

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: Never doubt the power of the square!

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: Don't annoy me with your roundspeak!

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: Mouths are made for eating, person.

string.name: c19_f3
string.value: All I'm saying is, I want a steak.

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: I prefer to be the mysterious type.

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: A little more appreciation would be appreciated, meow.

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: Is there anyone cuter then me in Maple World?

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: I like this weather. It should stay like this forever!

string.name: c20_s4
string.value: Aren't people in El Nath cold? Why live there?

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: Why couldn't you have said to sleep...

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: Do you like the Water of Life? What's it taste like?

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I wish I had cute clothes, too...

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: Let's have dinner sometime! Steak on you!

string.name: c21_f1
string.value: No! You're gonna yell at me for being loud!

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: Meow, meow, meow, I'm ignoring you!

string.name: f1_f
string.value: This is it? This is the best you can do?

string.name: f3_s
string.value: I like food! Five square meals a day!

string.name: f4_s
string.value: All my best memories are of eating!

string.name: s1
string.value: How can you say such a thing?!

string.name: c1_s2
string.value: Look how nicely Cube Hamster fits!

string.name: c1_f1
string.value: Uh oh, you're on Cube Hamster's bad side!

string.name: c1_f2
string.value: Square up if you want to deal with me!

string.name: c2_s1
string.value: I was feeling a bit tired. I should rest a bit!

string.name: c2_s3
string.value: I don't like walking! I want to stay sitting!

string.name: c2_s4
string.value: I did well, right? That means you'll feed me, yeah?

string.name: c2_f1
string.value: I don't want to sit! I won't sit!

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: If I sat, I'd look even smaller!

string.name: c3_s3
string.value: Cute, nice, funny... Cube Hamster rules!

string.name: c3_s4
string.value: I lost some weight, so it's easier to sit!

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: Feed me so I don't have to sit hungry!

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: Give me a reason. A tasty reason!

string.name: c3_f4
string.value: I don't want to do anything...

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: Man, it's actually pretty nice here!

string.name: c4_s3
string.value: The ground feels like it's going to give under my butt.

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: Nothing like a good sit! Except maybe a good meal...

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: No. I might sit on a bug!

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: I'm too hungry to be sitting...

string.name: c4_f3
string.value: I can't concentrate on that! I'm starving!

string.name: c4_f4
string.value: I'm starving and you still want me to sit...

string.name: c5_f2
string.value: Ooh, you're lucky Cube Hamster is so patient!

string.name: c6_s4
string.value: My little square heart is breaking!

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: Hmm? I was thinking about something else.

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: Why do you do this to me?!

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: I thought you were a nice person... Clearly not!

string.name: c7_s1
string.value: I'll be more careful... Please don't be angry...

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: I can't believe you have so little faith in me!

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: You said you liked me before...

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: Stop, or you'll be the one in trouble!

string.name: c9_f1
string.value: Uh oh, you're on Cube Hamster's bad side!

string.name: c9_f2
string.value: Square up if you want to deal with me!

string.name: c10_s3
string.value: Cube Hamster is full of love!

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: Why are there no square hearts?!

string.name: c11_s4
string.value: Yeah, well... I love you more.

string.name: c11_f2
string.value: I just like the food! Not you!

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: We fit together so super well!

string.name: c12_s2
string.value: You and me, squaring away this round world!

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: I know I can count on you!

string.name: c12_f1
string.value: You thought I'd say I love you, right? You were wrong!

string.name: c14_f3
string.value: Don't tell me to do that.

string.name: c14_f4
string.value: I'll do it when I want!

string.name: c16_f4
string.value: I don't fit in bed now!

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: I wanna sleep next to you! Zzz...

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: You have to wake me up early tomorrow...

string.name: c18_s4
string.value: I feel like I could sleep for 3 days straight...

string.name: c18_f1
string.value: Sleep? I don't know the meaning of the word!

string.name: c18_f2
string.value: I won't sleep. Stop trying to make me sleep.

string.name: c18_f3
string.value: Bring me a pillow and comforter, then.

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: Let's talk about food! I love food!

string.name: c19_s3
string.value: I'm the cutest, right? Not off-base with this?

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: I'm not gonna make a peep.

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: I'm Cube Hamster, not Chat Hamster!

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: I'm gonna stuff my face 'till I can't talk!

string.name: c20_f1
string.value: I don't know how to talk!

string.name: c20_f4
string.value: What do you want to hear from me?

string.name: c21_s1
string.value: I'm the happiest when I'm eating!

string.name: c21_s2
string.value: I want some seasoned short ribs today.

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: Okay! Er, what should we talk about?

string.name: c21_s4
string.value: We always talk about food. I like that!

string.name: c21_f3
string.value: Can't you see how tired I am?

string.name: f1_s
string.value: Time to eat! Best time of the day!

string.name: f3_f
string.value: I'm stuffed... I don't want to eat anymore.

string.name: f4_f
string.value: You're not feeding Cube Hamster THAT, are you?

string.name: s1
string.value: You shouldn't say things like that!

string.name: c1_s1
string.value: No joke, I saw an astronaut in a flying car the other day.

string.name: c1_s2
string.value: I'm just wearing a ring to fit in with the cool planets.

string.name: c1_f1
string.value: Huh? What? Sorry. I spaced out for a second there.

string.name: c1_f2
string.value: I'm literally too cool to talk to you.

string.name: c2_s1
string.value: They named that candy bar after me, you know.

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: Visit Mars! I'm more than just a cold, unfeeling rock.

string.name: c2_f1
string.value: Talk to me until we're both red in the face. I don't care.

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: I'm not interested in idle chat. Take a space hike!

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: Why diet when you can just tell people your Mars weight?

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: I like you. When humans colonize Mars, you should visit.

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: Talk to me after my next revolution. You know, *way* later.

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: I'm not Earth, okay?! I only kind of like people!

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: I'm so amazing, even Sinatra sang about me!

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I've had so many *opportunities* to make robot friends!

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: I'm not a space oddity! You're a space oddity!

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: Don't bother me! I'm named after a Roman god for a reason.

string.name: f1_s
string.value: Ah, I love a fresh surge of starlight in the morning!

string.name: f2_s
string.value: Wow! This stuff gets me totally wired!

string.name: f3_s
string.value: This star had a meaningful end... sustaining my molten core.

string.name: f3_f
string.value: You didn't even make it yourself!

string.name: f4_s
string.value: Dead stars are life! Or... well... They're life for me, I guess.

string.name: f4_f
string.value: Ah! It's too hot! What were you thinking?!

string.name: s1
string.value: You really think you can make ME feel guilty?

string.name: s2
string.value: You're insulting on a planetary scale!

string.name: s3
string.value: Stop everything you're doing. It's all wrong!

string.name: s4
string.value: Do you regret being mean, or are you as cold as my atmosphere?

string.name: c1_s1
string.value: My rings are all the bling I need.

string.name: c1_s2
string.value: You spin me right round, baby, right-- Oh wait, that's me!

string.name: c1_f1
string.value: I'm rotating, because I don't want to talk to you.

string.name: c1_f2
string.value: Can't you talk to someone a little closer to home?

string.name: c2_s1
string.value: How do you throw a swanky party in space? You plan-et, dahling.

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: My very educated mother just served us nine... What was it again?

string.name: c2_f1
string.value: No offense, but you've got to be an astronaut to hang with me.

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: In the vacuum of space, I can't hear a word you say.

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: All this rotating and revolving is bound to make a girl dizzy!

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: Nachos! My very educated mother just served us NACHOS!

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: My rings are so dusty! Let's chat after I've cleaned up.

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: I'm sorry. I can't sustain life or meaningful conversation.

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: That dog star never laughs at my jokes. He's way too Sirius.

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: Did you know they named a video game console after me?

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: When I'm ready to chat, I'll give you a ring.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: You're just like my 62 friends... always mooning over me.

string.name: f1_s
string.value: Ah, this is a meal fit for superstars!

string.name: f1_f
string.value: Someone as well-to-do as me deserves better.

string.name: f2_s
string.value: I love the taste of raw energy!

string.name: f2_f
string.value: Did you just grab the first supernova you found? Ew.

string.name: f3_s
string.value: Who needs energy drinks when you can have a supernova!

string.name: f3_f
string.value: This supernova might make me a little gassy...

string.name: f4_s
string.value: You really went above and beyond for this meal!

string.name: f4_f
string.value: Ew, it tastes like it's 10 billion years old!

string.name: s1
string.value: You're more hostile than my environment.

string.name: s2
string.value: I'll forgive you for that... this time.

string.name: s3
string.value: Ouch! And I thought I was cold.

string.name: s4
string.value: You're just jealous of my rings, aren't you?

string.name: c1_s1
string.value: Blue is my favorite color! Good thing, huh?

string.name: c1_s2
string.value: Earth keeps telling me to get a life...

string.name: c1_f1
string.value: Stop telling me jokes about cling-ons!

string.name: c1_f2
string.value: Why all the jokes?! I don't even *have* a butt!

string.name: c2_s1
string.value: Keep Earth clean! After all, it's not Uranus.

string.name: c2_s2
string.value: My rings might not be as flashy as Saturn's, but I like them.

string.name: c2_f1
string.value: Don't bother chatting. I'm stone cold to the core.

string.name: c2_f2
string.value: What about me screams warm and friendly to you?

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: I might be the coldest planet, but your heroism warms my core.

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: Visit Uranus! I've got enough helium to talk like a chipmunk!

string.name: c3_f1
string.value: You know what else emits noxious gasses?

string.name: c3_f2
string.value: Got tired of contemplating your bellybutton?

string.name: c4_s1
string.value: Whatever happened to the ninth planet? I miss that little guy...

string.name: c4_s2
string.value: I love being in your orbit!

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: I'd rather chill right now, if that's okay with you.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: Do we hafta chat? Orbiting the sun is so exhausting!

string.name: f1_s
string.value: Supernovas are almost as fun to look at as they are to eat.

string.name: f1_f
string.value: You're just trying to stuff me full of junk food!

string.name: f2_s
string.value: Mm... Maybe this will help me grow warm and volcano-y.

string.name: f2_f
string.value: If you are what you eat, then I should reconsider this...

string.name: f3_s
string.value: I'm picking up notes of tangy, flamey perfection!

string.name: f3_f
string.value: I'm a gas giant! Are you *trying* to make me explode?

string.name: f4_s
string.value: I like my meals like I like the sun... gaseous and blazing hot! Thanks!

string.name: f4_f
string.value: Oh, that definitely didn't agree with me...

string.name: s1
string.value: I'm cooler than a cucumber. You on the other hand...

string.name: s2
string.value: Watch it, or I might frostbite you!

string.name: s3
string.value: Is this how you treat all the friends in your orbit?

string.name: s4
string.value: I think I need some space... like, billions of miles of it.
